jobs.title: Head of Influencer Marketing
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Influencer Marketing Strategy: Lead the development and implementation of influencer marketing strategies for major consumer brands across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland (DACH). Creator Management: Oversee creator-related processes, ensuring effective collaboration with influencers and content creators throughout campaign planning and execution. Creative Concepts and Scriptwriting: Develop engaging creative concepts, campaign briefs, and scripts that align with brand objectives, resonate with target audiences, and encourage meaningful engagement. Campaign Development: Translate marketing objectives into compelling creator-led campaigns, ensuring creative consistency and alignment with each brand's positioning and goals. Founder Collaboration: Work closely with company founders to define priorities, refine creative strategies, and contribute to the overall growth of the business and its clients. Performance Analysis: Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), evaluate campaign results, and identify opportunities to improve content effectiveness and marketing outcomes. Creative Optimisation: Analyse content assets and identify successful creative formats, messaging approaches, and creator partnerships to strengthen campaign performance. Trend and Talent Discovery: Stay informed about emerging social media trends, creator opportunities, audience preferences, and high-performing content formats to maintain a competitive edge. Continuous Improvement: Apply insights from campaign performance and advanced creative training to refine processes, improve creative output, and support scalable influencer marketing operations. Requirements Relevant Experience: Proven experience in creative strategy, ideally within a marketing agency or brand environment, with a strong understanding of influencer marketing and creator-led campaigns. Influencer and Social Media Expertise: A solid understanding of social media platforms, creator ecosystems, audience engagement, and the factors that contribute to successful influencer campaigns. Creative Thinking: The ability to develop original concepts, write compelling scripts, and translate marketing objectives into engaging content ideas that resonate with target audiences. Trend Awareness: A strong instinct for identifying emerging social media trends, recognising high-performing content, and understanding what makes creators and campaigns successful. Analytical Skills: The ability to interpret campaign KPIs, evaluate creative performance, and use data-driven insights to optimise content and marketing strategies. Communication Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a genuine ability to understand people, build relationships, and collaborate effectively with creators and internal stakeholders. Strategic Mindset: The ability to connect creative execution with broader business objectives, prioritise effectively, and make informed decisions in a dynamic environment. Ownership and Initiative: A proactive, ambitious, and results-oriented approach, with the willingness to take responsibility, solve problems independently, and go the extra mile to achieve outstanding results. Commitment and Availability: The ability to dedicate the necessary time and energy to a demanding, growth-oriented role while maintaining high standards of execution. Remote Working Skills: Strong organisational skills and the ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and collaborate effectively in a fully remote environment. Benefits Competitive Salary: Earn between €5,000 and €10,000 per month, depending on experience and suitability for the role. Permanent Employment: Secure a long-term employment opportunity with the potential to grow alongside an expanding business. Fully Remote Work: Work from anywhere in the world. Flexible Working Hours: Enjoy flexibility in organising your schedule while remaining focused on campaign delivery and business outcomes. Professional Developme

jobs.title: Head of TikTok Shop
jobs.description: Accountabilities: TikTok Shop Strategy and Leadership: Take ownership of TikTok Shop operations and lead the strategic development of social commerce initiatives for major brands across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland (DACH). Business Growth: Identify and implement opportunities to increase sales, improve conversion rates, and strengthen brand performance on TikTok Shop. Founder Collaboration: Work closely with company founders to define strategic priorities, align commercial objectives, and drive the successful execution of growth initiatives. Performance Analysis: Monitor and analyse key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate results, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions that improve overall performance. Creative Optimisation: Assess content assets and creative approaches to identify top-performing formats, improve engagement, and maximise commercial impact. Trend Identification: Stay ahead of emerging TikTok trends, creator strategies, and social commerce developments to maintain a competitive advantage for the brands you manage. Continuous Improvement: Develop and implement scalable processes, test new approaches, and refine TikTok Shop strategies to support sustainable growth. Creative Excellence: Apply insights from advanced creative training to strengthen content performance, improve campaign effectiveness, and consistently pursue high-impact results. Requirements Relevant Experience: Demonstrable experience in e-commerce, influencer marketing, social media, social commerce, or a related field, with a strong understanding of digital growth strategies. TikTok and Social Media Expertise: A solid understanding of TikTok trends, creator ecosystems, audience behaviour, and the characteristics that make content perform successfully. Commercial and Analytical Skills: The ability to interpret performance metrics, identify growth opportunities, and translate data into practical optimisation strategies. Strategic Thinking: Strong business judgement and the ability to develop, implement, and continuously refine strategies that support measurable commercial outcomes. Communication and Relationship Management: Excellent communication skills, a natural ability to understand and work with people, and the confidence to collaborate closely with founders and other stakeholders. Creative Judgement: A strong instinct for identifying high-performing content, understanding audience preferences, and recognising opportunities to improve creative assets. Ownership and Drive: A proactive, ambitious, and results-oriented mindset, with a willingness to take initiative, assume responsibility, and go the extra mile to achieve business goals. Availability and Commitment: The ability to dedicate the necessary time and energy to a demanding, growth-focused role while maintaining consistent execution and accountability. jobs.title: After-Sales Specialist
jobs.description: Duties & Responsibilities: Vehicle Handover Prepare each car for handover, making sure it is clean and complete with all accessories: keys, manual, and spare tyre. Walk the customer through the car's condition and inspection report, and introduce its key features. Sign the handover form with the customer and document it with photos. Paperwork & Procedures Follow up on ownership transfer via Absher and the Traffic Department, and on insurance issuance with the relevant parties. Follow up on financing and instalments with finance providers when needed. Ensure contracts and invoices are complete and archived in the system. Warranty & Complaints Receive post-sale warranty requests and complaints, log them, and follow up until closed. Coordinate with approved maintenance workshops and the inspection team to resolve technical issues. Escalate complex cases to the Showroom Manager in line with approved procedures. Follow-Up & Customer Loyalty Contact every customer after their order is completed and the car is received, to confirm the car arrived in the agreed condition, that they have faced no technical, paperwork, or missing-accessory issues since handover, and whether they need further service or support. Schedule regular follow-up calls, for example within 3 days and again 30 days after handover. Open a ticket immediately for any issue the customer raises, follow it through to resolution, then check back to confirm they are satisfied. Log the outcome of every follow-up call and all customer data accurately in the CRM system. Offer relevant add-on services such as protection, window tinting, maintenance packages, and insurance. Gather customer feedback and submit a monthly report on recurring issues and improvement suggestions. Qualifications & Requirements: Saudi nationals only. High school diploma at minimum. A diploma or bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field is preferred. At least 2 years of experience in after-sales or customer service at car showrooms or dealerships. Valid Saudi driving licence. Knowledge of ownership transfer, insurance, and financing procedures in Saudi Arabia. Fluent in Arabic and good English. Nice to Have Previous experience in the used car market. Hands-on experience with CRM systems. Basic technical knowledge of car parts and inspection reports. Skills & Competencies: Strong communication skills and a courteous manner with customers. Calm and patient when handling complaints and upset customers. Accurate and organised in tracking documents and appointments. Able to solve problems and make decisions within their authority. Skilled at upselling without pressuring the customer. Proficient in basic computer tools, including Excel, email, and internal systems. A team player who coordinates well with Sales, Inspection, and Maintenance Key Performance Indicators: Post-handover customer satisfaction (CSAT): 90% or higher. Net Promoter Score (NPS): 50 or higher. First response time to complaints: within 24 hours. Complaint resolution rate: 90% within 7 days. Ownership transfer completion: within 3 working days of sale. Follow-up calls completed: 100% of customers. Add-on service sales: 20% of deals. CRM customer data accuracy: 95% or higher. Benefits: Competitive salary plus commission on add-on services. Medical insurance. A fast-growing Saudi tech company. Training and career growth opportunities.

jobs.title: IT Operations & Cybersecurity Specialist
jobs.description: Accountabilities: IT Administration: Provision and manage user accounts, groups, permissions, and licences across Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, ensuring secure and efficient access to business applications. Endpoint Management: Prepare and onboard Windows and macOS laptops into mobile device management (MDM) platforms, coordinate remote device handovers, and maintain appropriate device configurations. Technical Support: Handle first-line support requests, including password resets, access issues, and routine troubleshooting, while escalating more complex incidents when necessary. IT Maintenance and Monitoring: Conduct weekly maintenance checks covering software patch status, backup logs, security alerts, and general system health to help maintain reliable operations. Documentation and Process Improvement: Document technical fixes, standard operating procedures, and runbooks to improve consistency, knowledge sharing, and operational efficiency. Cybersecurity Projects: Dedicate approximately 20% of your time to security-focused initiatives, including CVE research and briefings, laptop hardening scripts, incident-response playbooks, and ISO 27001 checklist development. Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline IT workflows, strengthen security practices, and improve service delivery across a distributed client environment. Requirements Professional Experience: At least two years of hands-on experience in IT operations, helpdesk support, systems administration, or a comparable technical role. Cloud Administration: Practical experience administering Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, including user and group management, security policies, permissions, and basic troubleshooting. Endpoint Management: Familiarity with MDM solutions such as Microsoft Intune, Jamf, or equivalent platforms, including device enrolment and configuration. Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in at least one scripting language, such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python, with the ability to automate routine tasks and improve operational workflows. Communication Skills: Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to document technical processes clearly and collaborate effectively with distributed teams. German language skills are an advantage. Remote Working Readiness: A reliable internet connection, a professional remote working environment, and the ability to work independently across different time zones. Personal Attributes: A proactive, organised, and detail-oriented approach, with strong troubleshooting skills, sound judgement, and a willingness to learn and take ownership of responsibilities. Preferred Qualifications: Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, Microsoft 365 Endpoint Administrator, or Google Workspace Administrator certifications are advantageous. Security Knowledge: Exposure to cybersecurity and compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, or similar standards is a plus. Benefits Competitive Compensation: Hourly compensation within the advertised range of €10–€18, with the original role description specifying a typical rate of €12–€16 per hour, paid in euros. Fully Remote Work: Work remotely from anywhere. Autonomy and Ownership: Take responsibility for your area of work, manage your tasks independently, and contribute directly to operational improvements. Professional Development: Build practical cybersecurity experience through hands-on projects involving vulnerability research, endpoint hardening, incident response, and compliance. Career Growth: Opportunity to expand your responsibilities and progress into a broader role as the team grows. Flexible, Asynchronous Culture: Benefit from an async-first working environment, with occasional video meetings scheduled during hours compatible with Central European Time (CET). Practical Security Experience: Develop your technical capabilities while working across IT administration, endpoint management, automation, and security operations.

jobs.title: Product Manager Privacy
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As Product Manager Privacy, you will own the consent management strategy, lead the Privacy squad, and ensure that privacy requirements are consistently implemented across products and channels. Your main responsibilities will include: Consent Engine and Frameworks: Own the FastCMP consent signal engine roadmap, covering IAB TCF, GPP, Global Privacy Control (GPC), Google Consent Mode, and US privacy signals. Define the applicable frameworks and default behaviors for each jurisdiction, and deliver new standard versions on time across web, mobile, and CTV. Cross-Product Privacy Rules: Translate legislation and industry standards into clear product specifications for Actirise, Viously, and Meetscale across web, app, and CTV. Maintain a compliance checklist for consent-related initiatives and coordinate with product managers to ensure signals are correctly collected, respected, and transmitted. Privacy-Compliant Monetization: Identify opportunities to monetize traffic within applicable privacy rules. Distinguish mandatory requirements from recommendations, assess revenue implications before making decisions, and evaluate options for traffic with no or partial consent, including legitimate interest, contextual advertising, and no-ad requirements. Measurement and Decision-Making: Apply a measure-before-deciding approach, ensuring traffic is not rejected or degraded without supporting measurements and a documented decision. Compliance, Vendors, and Certifications: Own IAB TCF and Google CMP certifications, manage vendor lists and custom vendors, and mitigate the risk of deregistration. Work with the Data Protection Officer (DPO) to validate privacy interpretations while retaining product ownership of decisions. Client and Partner Engagement: Serve as the product point of contact for strategic clients and partners on privacy matters, including CMP migrations, regulatory requests, and buyer requirements. Regulatory and Standards Monitoring: Track upcoming legislation and industry standards, anticipate their product implications, and translate them into roadmap priorities before they become urgent. AI-Ready Product Management: Apply an agentic-first approach by ensuring privacy rules and configurations can be executed by AI agents, supported by clean data contracts and appropriate access controls. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Engagement, UX Orchestration, Analytics, FastCMP engineering, and the DPO to coordinate consent templates, A/B testing, CMP and paywall configurations, and privacy signal measurement. Requirements: The ideal candidate combines substantial privacy expertise with hands-on product management experience in advertising technology. You understand how to interpret legal requirements without unnecessarily restricting legitimate business opportunities, and you can translate complex rules into actionable technical specifications. The following qualifications are expected: Privacy and Product Experience: At least 5 years of experience in privacy, consent management platforms (CMPs), or ad tech, including product management experience and a proven track record of shipping products in this ecosystem. Industry Standards and Regulations: Strong knowledge of IAB TCF, Global Privacy Platform (GPP), OpenRTB consent fields, GDPR, ePrivacy, and US privacy legislation, including CCPA and applicable state laws. jobs.title: B2B Sales - Cold Caller / SDR mit Aufstiegschance zum High Ticket Closer
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Pipeline Generation and Outbound Sales Convert warm inbound responses into qualified opportunities for the growth consulting offering. Proactively identify and contact potential customers through phone calls, email campaigns, and LinkedIn outreach. Work with the existing CRM to identify prospects, activate contacts, and generate new sales conversations. Book discovery calls and maintain consistent pipeline generation activity. Sales Development and Learning Shadow senior sales leaders during sales meetings to learn effective prospecting, qualification, and closing techniques. Participate actively in advanced sales training and apply coaching and feedback to improve performance. Build a strong understanding of the B2B sales process, high-ticket offers, and the needs of target customers. Track results, refine outreach approaches, and adjust quickly based on feedback and performance. Career Progression Demonstrate consistent performance and readiness for increased sales responsibility. Progress toward a Discovery Representative role, with the opportunity to become a Full-Cycle Closer based on results. Build the skills required for long-term growth in high-ticket sales and potentially consulting. Requirements Native-level German proficiency is essential for communicating effectively with prospects in the DACH market. Previous B2B sales experience is helpful but not required; motivation, coachability, and a strong work ethic are the primary priorities. A competitive, ambitious mindset and a genuine desire to achieve measurable results. Confidence in handling rejection and persistence when prospecting and following up with potential customers. Strong learning agility, with the ability to take feedback and apply it immediately. A proactive, action-oriented approach, including the ability to make decisions, test strategies, and adapt without waiting for perfect clarity. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage prospects professionally across phone, email, and LinkedIn. Discipline, resilience, and consistent personal habits; an athletic background or strong commitment to physical fitness is valued. Comfort working in a performance-based environment where earning potential is closely linked to results. A willingness to learn high-ticket sales techniques directly from experienced practitioners and invest sustained effort in professional development. Benefits On-target earnings: €60,000, with uncapped commission and the potential for high performers to earn more than €100,000 annually. Flexible work arrangement: Remote-first work environment with the freedom to work from anywhere, provided performance expectations are met. Career advancement: A defined progression path from Pipeline Representative to Discovery Representative, Full-Cycle Closer, and potentially consulting. Direct sales coaching: One-to-one coaching and opportunities to shadow experienced sales leaders during live sales activities. Advanced sales training: Access to a structured training program built on approximately 15 years of experience and more than 400 client cases. Executive coaching: Personalized development support from an executive coach with a former VP-level background at Nike, valued at more than €5,000 and provided at the company’s expense after onboarding. Established sales infrastructure: Access to a proprietary sales platform that generates warm leads daily and a CRM containing more than 50,000 active DACH-market contacts. Attractive B2B sales proposition: Work with an offer featuring an average deal size of approximately €20,000, a typical sales cycle of two to three weeks, and a reported closing rate of 30–40%. Performance-focused team: Collaborate with a small, ambitious team that values accountability, discipline, learning, and high performance. Contract flexibility: The role begins on a freelance basis, with the possibility—and stated intention in suitable cases—of transitioning to permanent employment

jobs.description: About Welo Global Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com Job Overview We are looking for a Financial Accountant to join our multinational, multi-currency European Finance team. The ideal candidate must be a self-starter, organised and flexible. We are looking for someone that has excellent interpersonal skills and ability to prioritise with a strong focus on quality, team work and adherence to global deadlines. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills are essential. Main Responsibilities: Strong Financial Accounting knowledge with robust experience in preparing monthly financial statements as this position will own the entire financial reporting cycle for multiple European legal entities Revenue and regulatory filings, both US Gaap and local statutory Management of outsource payroll providers, local payroll and employer taxes reporting monthly Global Transfer Pricing, working with external providers to produce annual TP documentation per country within the organisation Provision of data for multi-currency weekly, monthly and forecast working capital requirements Preparation and analysis of Trial Balance and Financial Statements Detailed review of Trial Balance Monthly reporting requirements Knowledge of IFRS / FRS102 Budget to Actual analysis Assistance in the preparation of audit and corporation taxations requirements and liaison with team leads Ad hoc projects with the wider Accounting team Requirements: Proficiency in Workday would be an advantage (or similar ERP software), proficient MS Excel skills (use of pivot tables, excellent knowledge of formulas) is essential. Knowledge, understanding and application of EU VAT regulation and reporting Accounting qualification – newly qualified or experienced with 2-3 years of working in similar environment Ability to work in an international remote team Qualified Accountant Proven track of experience in Accounts roles/functions Transfer pricing knowledge Committed, flexible and enthusiastic, team player Ability to take initiative

jobs.title: Founding Account Executive
jobs.description: Accountabilities: New Business Development Follow up with qualified company registrations and inbound leads to understand customer needs and identify opportunities for broader adoption. Convert individual users into team, departmental, and enterprise-level customers. Develop relationships with prospective customers and identify opportunities to expand the customer base across relevant market segments. Account Growth and Expansion Manage and develop existing customer accounts, increasing adoption across additional teams and product modules. Identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities for CRM, WhatsApp, AI-powered notes, e-signatures, invoicing, and other platform capabilities. Build long-term customer relationships by understanding evolving business needs and demonstrating relevant product value. Full-Cycle Sales and Deal Closing Own the sales process from discovery and product demonstrations through proposals, negotiations, security and legal reviews, and contract signature. Manage booked sales meetings and maintain momentum throughout the sales cycle. Work directly with the founders on strategic opportunities and high-value deals. Consistently monitor sales performance and work toward agreed revenue and activity targets. Sales Process Development Build the foundational sales infrastructure, including pipeline management, CRM standards, forecasting, sales playbooks, and effective handover processes. Document successful approaches and turn individual wins into repeatable sales practices. Track performance data, identify process improvements, and establish a more predictable approach to revenue growth. Strategic and Cross-Functional Collaboration Share customer feedback and market insights to influence pricing, packaging, product development, and go-to-market strategy. Work closely with the founders to prioritize opportunities and refine the commercial approach. Help establish a scalable sales motion that can support future team expansion and entry into additional markets. Requirements Approximately 4–8 years of B2B software sales experience, including at least 2 years with direct responsibility for closing deals. Native-level German proficiency or German at C2 level, together with good English communication skills. Demonstrated experience independently managing the full sales cycle, including discovery, product demonstrations, proposals, security and legal discussions, negotiations, and closing. Proven ability to expand existing customer accounts, in addition to acquiring new customers. Strong understanding of sales performance metrics, with the ability to clearly communicate targets, attainment, average contract value, and average sales cycle length from previous roles. Experience maintaining accurate CRM records, managing pipeline activity, forecasting, and building structured sales processes. Strong commercial judgment, customer discovery skills, and the ability to identify opportunities for broader product adoption. An independent, accountable, and execution-focused working style, with the confidence to communicate early when assumptions or strategies are not working. Comfort operating in a fast-growing environment where processes are still being developed and priorities may evolve quickly. Preferred experience: Working in a bootstrapped, profitable, or rapidly scaling software company with fewer than 200 employees. Preferred experience: Managing longer sales cycles involving German mid-market and enterprise customers. Preferred experience: Building repeatable sales processes from product-led growth or inbound demand. A specific degree, corporate background, prior knowledge of the product, or residence in Cologne is not required. Practical sales performance, customer understanding, transparency, and reliable execution are the priorities. Benefits Competitive compensation: €45,000–€55,000 annual base salary plus €65,000–€75,000 in target variable compensation, for total on-target earnings of €110,000–€130,000 at 100%

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer (Mid-level)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Improve CI/CD pipelines: Analyze existing deployment pipelines, determine the requirements of new tasks, and adapt established workflows to support reliable, repeatable software delivery. Develop infrastructure-as-code: Extend and maintain infrastructure modules in line with existing repository patterns, ensuring consistency, reliability, and maintainability across services. Apply data governance standards: Implement naming conventions, access controls, retention policies, and other governance requirements for new data services and infrastructure. Build self-service platform tooling: Develop and maintain a reusable template repository with preconfigured CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and governance standards so engineering teams can launch new pipelines with minimal manual intervention. Create reusable modules: Build tools and modules that simplify pipeline creation and reduce repetitive engineering work, making common platform tasks accessible through standardized workflows. Improve technical documentation: Write practical documentation, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides that help engineers understand and operate systems independently without relying on individual team members. Own data access workflows: Design and manage access-request processes for data resources, reducing bottlenecks and enabling teams to obtain the permissions they need efficiently. Take ownership of platform tooling: Progress toward full responsibility for the template repository and infrastructure modules, including technical direction, prioritization, maintenance, and roadmap decisions. Collaborate across engineering disciplines: Work with data engineers, backend engineers, and infrastructure specialists to improve platform reliability and make shared tools useful across teams. Use AI tools responsibly: Incorporate AI-assisted development tools into everyday workflows while validating generated code, identifying potential errors, and explaining the reasoning behind technical decisions. Requirements Deployment ownership: Demonstrated experience independently owning a deployment path end to end, including building a pipeline, troubleshooting failures, resolving production issues, and documenting the solution in a runbook. Professional experience: Approximately two years or more of professional experience in software, data, platform, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering. Technical education: A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Python and SQL: Practical working knowledge of both languages and the ability to use them regularly in professional engineering tasks. CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code: Experience working with deployment pipelines and infrastructure-as-code practices, with the ability to understand, adapt, and improve existing implementations. Code analysis and troubleshooting: Ability to navigate an unfamiliar codebase, explain how it works, identify potential failure points, and make sound technical judgments. Containers and cloud: Experience with Docker and familiarity with cloud computing concepts, particularly AWS. Previous experience with specific services such as SageMaker is not required. Cross-functional technical skills: Willingness and ability to work across data engineering, backend systems, and infrastructure rather than focusing exclusively on one area. AI-assisted development: Comfortable using AI coding assistants such as Copilot, Claude, or Cursor. You must be able to review generated code critically, explain why it is correct, and recognize when it is inaccurate or unsafe. Ownership and accountability: A proactive mindset, willingness to take responsibility for systems you modify, and honesty about failures, root causes, and lessons learned. Respect for established patterns: Ability to understand existing architecture and engineering conventions before deciding what should change. Communication and reasoning: Comfortable explaining technical decisions, defending implementation choice

jobs.title: Creative Strategist
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As a Creative Strategist, you will lead the development and execution of creative concepts that help established consumer brands strengthen their digital presence and achieve their marketing objectives. Your responsibilities will include: Managing the end-to-end creative process for leading brands across the DACH market. Developing innovative creative concepts and content strategies tailored to brand objectives and target audiences. Writing scripts for organic social media content, advertisements, and marketing campaigns. Collaborating closely with the founders to align creative initiatives with broader business and marketing strategies. Analyzing campaign KPIs and content performance to identify opportunities for improvement. Continuously testing and optimizing creative assets, messaging, and formats to maximize audience engagement and campaign effectiveness. Monitoring social media trends, emerging formats, and high-performing content to inform creative decisions. Contributing to the development of creative best practices and helping brands maintain a competitive edge across digital platforms. Requirements: We are looking for a creative, analytical, and proactive professional with a strong understanding of digital content and the ability to turn audience insights into effective creative concepts. The ideal candidate will bring: Demonstrable experience in creative strategy, ideally within a marketing agency or brand environment. A strong understanding of social media platforms, content formats, and emerging digital trends. The ability to identify high-performing content and translate successful approaches into compelling creative concepts. Experience developing scripts and concepts for organic social content, advertisements, and marketing campaigns. Strong creative thinking, storytelling, and copywriting skills. The ability to analyze performance metrics and use insights to improve creative effectiveness. jobs.title: Head of Sales - B2B
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As Head of Sales, you will take ownership of the commercial strategy and execution, building the team, processes, and performance framework needed to support sustainable growth. Experience managing sales pipelines and implementing structured, repeatable sales processes. The ability to interpret sales KPIs and translate performance data into actionable improvements. Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with a strong understanding of customer needs. A proactive, results-oriented mindset and the ability to take full ownership of commercial outcomes. A hands-on approach, high standards of accountability, and a willingness to go the extra mile. Full-time availability and a strong commitment to driving business growth. Benefits: Competitive compensation: €8,000–€15,000 per month. Permanent employment contract for long-term professional stability. Fully remote work: Flexibility to work from anywhere in the world. jobs.title: Engineering Tech Lead (Product Security)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Penetration Testing and Security Assessments: Conduct hands-on penetration testing of products and infrastructure to identify and exploit vulnerabilities, with particular focus on Kubernetes environments, container isolation, and cloud-native systems. Vulnerability Management: Investigate, triage, prioritize, and remediate security vulnerabilities in application code and dependencies, taking ownership from discovery through patch development, release, and verification. Threat Modeling and Secure Design: Review new features and security-sensitive architectural designs early in the development lifecycle, identify potential attack paths, assess risks, and recommend practical mitigations. Kubernetes Security: Analyze Kubernetes attack surfaces, including container breakout risks, privilege escalation, role-based access control (RBAC), admission control, and security policy configurations. Kubernetes Internals and Infrastructure Security: Apply a strong understanding of Kubernetes components, including the API server, controllers, admission mechanisms, and kubelet, to identify weaknesses and strengthen system security. Code and Architecture Reviews: Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical reviews to identify security issues and promote robust engineering practices. Secure Engineering Practices: Work with engineers across the organization to embed secure defaults, security checks, and threat-aware development practices into the product lifecycle. Production Software Development: Build, maintain, and improve production-grade software using Go, contributing directly to secure and reliable infrastructure components. Security Communication and Collaboration: Explain vulnerabilities, attack scenarios, and remediation priorities clearly to engineering stakeholders, helping teams make informed security decisions. Continuous Security Improvement: Strengthen security processes, vulnerability handling practices, and engineering standards as the platform and its threat landscape evolve. Requirements Hands-on experience conducting penetration tests and identifying and exploiting vulnerabilities in production systems. Deep practical expertise in Kubernetes security, particularly container isolation, container breakout scenarios, privilege escalation, RBAC, and security policy best practices. Strong understanding of Kubernetes internals, including the API server, admission control, controllers, RBAC, and kubelet. Experience building Kubernetes controllers or operators using tools such as controller-runtime, Kubebuilder, or client-go is highly relevant. Demonstrated experience with threat modeling, secure system design, and reviewing production architectures for security risks. Professional experience building and shipping production systems with Go as a primary programming language. Strong software engineering fundamentals, including code review, debugging, secure development practices, and practical risk assessment. Familiarity with open-source development and cloud-native infrastructure projects. jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Plan, implement, and optimize CRM campaigns using Braze, with a focus on advanced audience segmentation, targeting, and personalized customer engagement. Develop, test, and refine HTML modifications within Braze templates to ensure consistent layouts and functionality across devices and email clients. Design and execute A/B tests across CRM campaigns, analyze results, and use findings to continuously improve engagement, conversion, and retention metrics. Monitor campaign performance using mobile analytics platforms, identify optimization opportunities, and communicate actionable recommendations to stakeholders and clients. Provide technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and training to team members on Braze capabilities and its integration with other marketing tools and platforms. jobs.title: Partner Engagement Specialist (6 months contract)
jobs.description: About Welocalize Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale. Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com MAIN PURPOSE OF ROLE The Partner Engagement Team is responsible for measuring, monitoring, and optimizing performance of suppliers within a particular set of languages. Performance includes, but is not limited to, on-time delivery, adherence to all client and project specific requirements, and defect-free deliverables. This Team is responsible for understanding customer capacity requirements as communicated by the Program Squads and liaising with Talent Procurement to ensure such capacity requirements can be met. As part of ensuring capacity, the Partner Engagement Team will monitor supplier utilization and advise supplier selection to the Program Squads accordingly. Monitor utilization to ensure supplier usage is in alignment with strategies as defined by Program Operations, Partner Success, and Language Operations. Engage with Program Squads should adjustment in resource usage be necessary. Communicate with and support Talent Procurement in the creation of new recruitment campaigns to identify and onboard new suppliers to Welocalize. Ensure regular quality measuring of suppliers in alignment with Welocalize LQA strategy. Monitor and flag suppliers performing beneath defined Welocalize thresholds. Supplier performance is inclusive of OTD, time-to-accept task, language quality, adherence to instructions, etc. Initiate Quality Improvement Plan (QIP), RCAs or CAPAs, as needed. If QIP is deemed unsuccessful, inform Talent Procurement. Produce audit-ready evidence for ISO 27001 and SOC 2, and carry out background and location-eligibility checks under the client’s vendor requirements. Reporting and improvement. Track SLAs such as time-to-provision, deprovisioning timeliness and MTTR, and look for automation to cut cycle time and errors. jobs.title: Technical Support Specialist (SaaS | SQL)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Troubleshoot production issues: Investigate and resolve technical problems across database, application, and infrastructure layers in a live SaaS environment. Use SQL for diagnostics: Write and execute SQL queries to investigate system behavior, identify data inconsistencies, troubleshoot incidents, and support root-cause analysis. Maintain system performance: Identify performance bottlenecks, monitor production environments, and take proactive steps to prevent issues from escalating. Support enterprise clients: Communicate directly with technical client stakeholders to understand issues, explain findings, and coordinate troubleshooting activities. Collaborate with engineering teams: Escalate complex cases, provide clear technical information, and work with engineers to investigate and resolve persistent or advanced issues. Monitor and maintain production environments: Use monitoring, logging, and diagnostic tools to identify potential problems and support the stability and reliability of business-critical systems. Improve internal processes: Strengthen technical documentation, share troubleshooting knowledge, and contribute to more effective support workflows during quieter periods. Work across a broad technology stack: Support systems involving Microsoft Azure, SQL Server, .NET, Angular, remote servers, and third-party integrations. Investigate integrations and related issues: Help troubleshoot systems involving single sign-on (SSO), payment platforms, reporting tools such as Power BI, and related technologies. Requirements: Professional technical support experience: At least 3 years of experience in technical support within a SaaS or software environment is essential. Strong SQL skills: Proven ability to write SQL queries, investigate production data, troubleshoot database issues, and work confidently with live systems. Production application support: Experience supporting web-based applications in production environments, ideally where availability and reliability are critical. Cross-layer troubleshooting: Ability to investigate technical issues across databases, applications, and networks, using a structured approach to identify root causes. Remote server experience: Comfortable accessing and troubleshooting remote environments using Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) and similar tools. Technical communication: Strong English communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to clients and internal teams. Initiative and ownership: A self-starter who takes responsibility for investigations, works independently, and proactively identifies opportunities to resolve or prevent problems. Preferred qualifications: French and/or Spanish language skills. Experience with Microsoft technologies such as .NET, IIS, and Azure. Exposure to Level 2 (L2) or Level 3 (L3) support and production support operations. Familiarity with single sign-on protocols and technologies, including SAML and OAuth. Experience collaborating with distributed teams in a remote working environment. Familiarity with tools such as Jira, SQL Profiler, monitoring and logging platforms, and reporting solutions such as Power BI. Benefits: Fully remote work: Work remotely from Poland while collaborating with clients and colleagues in a distributed environment. Hands-on technical experience: Gain direct exposure to production databases, live systems, and complex technical troubleshooting. Broad technology exposure: Develop practical experience across Azure, SQL Server, .NET, Angular, and enterprise integrations. Career development opportunities: Build a strong technical foundation for progression into senior support, DevOps, or engineering-adjacent roles. Meaningful problem-solving: Move beyond basic support tasks to investigate root causes, improve performance, and contribute to system reliability. Cross-functional collaboration: Work directly with technical client stakeholders and engineering teams on challenging, real-worl

jobs.description: Accountabilities: Design and develop course content: Collaborate with the curriculum team to define course structure, sections, lessons, practical labs, and notebooks that support progressive learning. Create hands-on learning experiences: Write detailed lab specifications for the dedicated lab development team, then test the completed environments to ensure they work as intended. Write engaging educational scripts: Develop short, story-driven video lessons of approximately six minutes each, making machine learning concepts accessible, intuitive, and relevant to engineers. Deliver technical presentations: Narrate scripted lessons confidently in English and record demonstrations and lab-solution walkthroughs that reinforce key concepts. Apply practical machine learning expertise: Build course material grounded in real experience with training, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models. Incorporate editorial feedback: Work through structured reviews, particularly during the initial course section, and refine content to meet established quality and teaching standards. Collaborate remotely: Coordinate with curriculum and production teams through weekly syncs and Slack, maintaining sufficient time-zone overlap with colleagues based in Europe and Asia. Focus on teaching and technical content: Partner with the production team, which manages video editing, animation, lab infrastructure, and publishing. Excellent English proficiency: Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to write natural scripts, deliver clear narration, and communicate confidently on camera. A genuine passion for teaching: Evidence of enjoying knowledge-sharing through online courses, tutorials, technical talks, workshops, mentoring, or other educational activities. Current technical knowledge: An active interest in machine learning developments and a commitment to continuously learning and improving. Presentation confidence: Comfort presenting technical material on camera in a clear, engaging, and accessible way. Openness to feedback: Willingness to follow an established teaching methodology, collaborate with editors, and improve course content through structured feedback. Preferred qualifications: Experience publishing courses on platforms such as Udemy, Pluralsight, or Coursera, or creating educational content on YouTube. Experience writing a technical book or teaching at a university, bootcamp, or similar educational setting. Practical knowledge of fine-tuning, MLOps, or deploying machine learning models in production. Cloud machine learning certifications related to AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or Databricks. Benefits: Competitive project-based compensation: A fixed fee is agreed upfront for each course, based on its length and technical complexity, with competitive rates for advanced topics and exceptional instructors. Develop content that demonstrates how engineers use AI agents, coding assistants, and LLM-based automation in real infrastructure environments. Ensure lessons are technically accurate, relevant, practical, and aligned with the needs of working engineers. Create engaging instructional content Write concise, story-driven video scripts designed to explain technical concepts clearly, with individual lessons typically lasting around six minutes. Use AI tools where helpful during drafting while ensuring the final scripts reflect your own voice, expertise, and teaching style. Narrate and present lessons confidently in English, making complex technical topics approachable for learners at different experience levels. Develop and validate hands-on labs Write detailed specifications for practical labs that demonstrate real-world DevOps and AI workflows. Collaborate with the dedicated labs team responsible for building the lab environments. Test completed labs, validate technical accuracy, and ensure exercises deliver the intended learning outcomes. Record demonstrations and walkthroughs explaining how to complete lab exercises and solve practical challenges. Collaborate on quality and editorial development Work closely with curriculum and production teams throughout the course development process. Incorporate structured editorial feedback, particularly during the initial course section, to align content with established teaching standards. Participate in regular team syncs and maintain communication through collaboration tools such as Slack. Focus on technical expertise, teaching, scripting, and recording while the production team manages video editing, animation, lab infrastructure, and publishing. Requirements: Hands-on DevOps and infrastructure experience Strong practical knowledge of Linux, containers, Kubernetes, at least one major cloud platform, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code (IaC). Experience building, operating, and maintaining infrastructure rather than relying solely on theoretical knowledge. The ability to demonstrate real engineering workflows and translate practical experience into effective learning materials. Current experience with AI technologies Practical experience using AI tools in engineering work, including AI agents, coding assistants, and LLM-based automation. Genuine curiosity about emerging AI capabilities and a commitment to staying current with new tools and techniques. The ability to explain how AI can support infrastructure engineering and DevOps workflows; deep specialization in AI research is not required. Teaching and communication skills A demonstrated passion for teaching, supported by experience creating courses, publishing tutorials, delivering talks or workshops, mentoring colleagues, or sharing technical knowledge with a community. Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly, naturally, and confidently on camera. Strong storytelling skills and the ability to break down complex technical concepts into simple, structured explanations. Empathy for learners, particularly beginners, and an understanding of how to make technical material engaging and accessible. Collaboration and adaptability Willingness to follow an established teaching methodology and incorporate constructive editorial feedback. Ability to work independently, organize deliverables, and meet an agreed project schedule. Comfort working remotely with a distributed team, including participation in weekly syncs and some time-zone overlap with colleagues based in Europe and Asia. Additional qualifications considered an advantage Previously published online courses on platforms such as Udemy or Pluralsight, or experience authoring a technical book. jobs.title: Staff Data Analyst
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Own analytics across the customer-facing business, covering enterprise partners, self-service customers, API adoption, booking performance, and commercial outcomes. Partner closely with senior Product, Engineering, and commercial leaders to define analytical priorities, challenge assumptions, and translate business questions into data-driven decisions. Build, validate, and maintain reliable dbt models, data pipelines, and analytical products that consolidate fragmented data sources into consistent, trusted reporting. Establish standardized metrics and reporting frameworks to resolve discrepancies between dashboards and provide a reliable view of product and business performance. Analyze customer journeys, API usage, and booking behavior to identify friction points, uncover conversion opportunities, and improve customer activation and retention. Develop product analytics capabilities and introduce experimentation frameworks, including hypothesis development, experiment design, and performance measurement. Investigate complex marketplace data across multiple products, systems, and fragmented hotel supply networks to uncover trends, operational challenges, and growth opportunities. Take analytical initiatives from initial discovery and solution design through implementation, validation, and adoption, ensuring that data products deliver measurable business value. Use AI coding agents and automation tools to accelerate development and analysis while maintaining data quality, reliability, and technical standards. Operate independently in an evolving environment, prioritizing high-impact opportunities, defining solutions with limited specifications, and delivering results with minimal oversight. Help shape analytics practices, data standards, and ways of working as the wider data organization continues to develop. Requirements Extensive experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, or a closely related discipline, with a track record of independently owning complex analytical initiatives. Proven experience working closely with senior Product, Engineering, or business leaders, influencing decisions through clear insights and a strong understanding of commercial priorities. Strong hands-on expertise in analytics engineering, including designing, developing, and validating dbt models, data pipelines, and end-to-end analytical solutions. Demonstrated ability to transform fragmented or complex datasets into reliable, well-structured data products that stakeholders can confidently use. Strong understanding of product analytics, customer behavior, conversion funnels, API adoption, and the relationship between product performance and business outcomes. Experience working in startups or scaleups, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, adapt to changing priorities, and deliver meaningful results in environments with limited structure. Practical experience using AI coding agents or AI-powered development tools to improve productivity, automate workflows, and accelerate implementation without compromising quality. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex questions, identify root causes, and turn findings into actionable recommendations. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to challenge assumptions constructively and explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences. A high degree of autonomy, ownership, and accountability, combined with the ability to connect individual analytical projects to broader business and product objectives. Nice to have: Experience with product analytics and experimentation, including designing experiments and evaluating their impact on customer adoption, conversion, and growth. Background in marketplace businesses, platform companies, travel technology, or other complex, multi-sided digital ecosystems. jobs.title: Game Producer: Platform Games
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Own the full lifecycle of multiple game titles, from strategic planning and concept development to production, testing, launch, and live operations. Develop game strategies, evaluate creative concepts, and pitch new titles and intellectual properties for the platform games portfolio. Coordinate internal developers, designers, QA teams, and external studios to maintain alignment, resolve blockers, and deliver projects on time. Lead Agile and Scrum processes, including sprint planning, stand-ups, production schedules, and roadmap tracking across multiple concurrent titles. Maintain accurate production trackers and dashboards, ensuring clear visibility into project status, ownership, milestones, deadlines, and dependencies. Manage relationships with platform partners, including Reddit and MSN, overseeing submission processes, technical requirements, and launch certifications. Coordinate external studios and vendors, manage production expectations, and work with legal and licensing teams to secure intellectual property rights and approvals. Monitor key performance indicators, including the number of live games, revenue per daily player, and engagement metrics, and provide regular weekly performance reports. Identify production risks, anticipate schedule delays, develop mitigation plans, and oversee release management to ensure successful launches. Explore emerging distribution channels, including Discord, YouTube Playables, and Telegram, to identify opportunities for portfolio expansion. Use performance data and stakeholder feedback to prioritize improvements, evaluate opportunities, and make informed production decisions. Requirements At least 3 years of experience as a Game Producer or Associate Producer, preferably within casual, mobile, browser, or platform gaming. Proven experience managing the complete game production lifecycle and successfully shipping titles with both internal teams and external or outsourced development partners. Working knowledge of Unity and HTML5 game development pipelines, including relevant production workflows and evolving platform technologies. Practical experience with Agile and Scrum methodologies, sprint planning, scheduling, and managing deliverables in an active production environment. Strong project management, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple titles, competing priorities, and cross-functional teams simultaneously. Experience coordinating platform partner launches, submissions, technical requirements, and certification processes. Demonstrated ability to manage external studio and vendor relationships, monitor delivery commitments, and proactively address timeline and production risks. Comfort working with dashboards, revenue metrics, player engagement data, and other performance indicators to inform decisions about game releases, priorities, and ongoing improvements. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, international environment. Excellent collaboration skills and the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders across different time zones. Nice to have: A strong interest in retro and arcade gaming, along with familiarity with classic game franchises and their potential for modern platforms. Experience using data-driven insights, including revenue-per-player and engagement metrics, to make informed decisions about launching, continuing, or discontinuing projects. Familiarity with emerging digital distribution channels and new opportunities for casual gaming experiences. Benefits Remote and flexible working: A trust-based work environment with flexibility in how you organize your work, while maintaining core working-hour overlap with European and Indian time zones. jobs.title: Asset Designer: Platform Games
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Produce complete, platform-compliant asset packages, including capsule art, hero banners, app icons, splash screens, store graphics, and social media adaptations. Adapt and optimize key art for distribution platforms such as MSN, Reddit, YouTube Playables, and Netflix Games, ensuring compatibility with different aspect ratios, display resolutions, and technical requirements. Prepare production-ready layered source files in Photoshop and Illustrator, including clean alpha channels, clearly separated foreground and background elements, and parallax-ready assets for user interfaces and startup screens. Create, format, and optimize 2D and 3D game assets, vector graphics, and Blender models for lightweight WebGL and HTML5 game integration. Design, refine, and maintain in-game UI components, HUD elements, and promotional graphics to ensure visual consistency and usability. Organize source files, version control, naming conventions, and directory structures to enable seamless integration into engineering and publishing workflows. Review and validate deliverables against technical specifications, platform guidelines, safe zones, and compliance requirements before final handoff. Incorporate feedback from licensors and stakeholders, accurately applying legal notices, brand guidelines, logo requirements, and visual identity standards. Coordinate asynchronously with cross-functional teams and external partners to deliver high-quality assets according to project milestones and publishing schedules. Requirements At least 3 years of professional experience in 2D or 3D game asset design, platform asset adaptation, or web and HTML5 game production. A strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality key art, store capsule design, and optimized visual assets for commercial game releases. Hands-on experience creating, adapting, or delivering platform games and interactive assets for major distribution environments, such as MSN, Reddit, YouTube Playables, Netflix Games, or comparable platforms. Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop and Illustrator, including non-destructive editing, compositing, vector creation, and batch automation. Proficiency in Blender for 3D modeling, rendering, and optimization of assets for web-based environments. Familiarity with HTML5, WebGL, and Unity asset pipelines, including their technical constraints and optimization requirements. A strong understanding of platform-specific asset specifications, safe zones, UI/UX requirements, and aspect ratios across web and streaming environments. Excellent knowledge of graphic design fundamentals, including composition, typography, and color theory, with the ability to maintain visual quality across multiple formats. Proven ability to follow corporate visual identity standards, logo lockups, typography rules, and established brand guidelines. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and operational discipline, with experience working in milestone-driven production environments. Excellent asynchronous communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with distributed teams. Availability to work remotely with core working-hour overlap across European and Indian time zones. Nice to have: Motion graphics and video editing experience for animated store capsules, promotional trailers, and end cards. Experience coordinating intellectual property approval workflows with external brand licensors. Familiarity with Spine 2D or frame-by-frame sprite animation. Experience using AI-assisted design tools, such as generative fill and image upscaling, while ensuring full copyright compliance and respecting intellectual property requirements. jobs.title: Payment Support Specialist
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Customer support: Deliver high-quality customer assistance through email, live chat, and ticketing systems, ensuring timely, professional, and helpful responses. Payment issue resolution: Handle payment-related inquiries, including transaction status, failed payments, troubleshooting, and general account questions. Payment process guidance: Explain payment flows, available options, and transaction procedures clearly to users and partners, helping them navigate financial services confidently. Investigation and troubleshooting: Analyze customer issues, identify root causes, and collaborate with technical teams to resolve complex payment and account-related problems. Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with developers, testers, product managers, and other internal stakeholders to investigate incidents and improve platform performance. Customer feedback and product improvement: Identify recurring issues, document user feedback, and share actionable insights that help improve products, payment processes, and customer satisfaction. CRM and case management: Maintain accurate, detailed records of customer interactions, payment incidents, and resolutions within CRM and ticketing systems. Support documentation: Contribute to the creation, maintenance, and improvement of FAQs, internal knowledge bases, troubleshooting guides, and customer support documentation. Process optimization: Identify opportunities to streamline support workflows, improve response quality, and enhance operational efficiency through better tools and procedures. Shift coverage: Follow the designated 3/3 rotational schedule, covering two day shifts and one night shift, while maintaining consistent support quality across working periods. Requirements English proficiency at B2 level or above, alongside Russian language proficiency, with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages. Previous experience in customer support, preferably within fintech, payment services, financial technology, or digital product environments. Practical understanding of payment processes, including payment gateways, transaction flows, payment troubleshooting, and basic financial compliance principles. Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities, with a structured approach to investigating issues, identifying root causes, and delivering effective solutions. Excellent customer service skills, including empathy, patience, active listening, and the ability to communicate complex information clearly. Strong attention to detail and accuracy when handling financial transactions, documenting customer interactions, and resolving payment-related issues. Ability to remain calm under pressure, manage multiple requests efficiently, and maintain high service standards in a fast-paced environment. A proactive, adaptable mindset, with a willingness to learn new technologies, support tools, payment methods, and product features. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with colleagues in an international, distributed team. Good time management and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet response and resolution expectations. Familiarity with CRM platforms, customer support ticketing systems, knowledge bases, or support automation tools is an advantage. Experience supporting cryptocurrency products, blockchain-based services, or other digital payment solutions is a plus. Previous experience working remotely or in a globally distributed team is desirable. Flexibility to work the required rotational schedule, including daytime and nighttime shifts. Benefits Fully remote work: Work from anywhere within a globally distributed team. Flexible working environment: Benefit from a remote-first culture that supports autonomy and flexibility within the required shift rotation. Career development: Access opportunities for professional growth in the rapidly evolving fintech and digital payments industries. Continuous learnin

jobs.title: Senior iOS Developer (Swift)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Native iOS development: Develop, maintain, and enhance native iOS applications using Swift, delivering new features and improving existing functionality. UI development: Build and optimize user interfaces using SwiftUI and/or UIKit, ensuring consistency, responsiveness, and a high-quality user experience. Application performance and stability: Maintain robust application architecture, optimize performance, identify technical issues, and uphold high standards of code quality and reliability. Accessibility implementation: Design, implement, and refine accessibility features across native iOS applications to support users with diverse needs and abilities. VoiceOver integration: Ensure seamless compatibility with VoiceOver by optimizing screen-reader behavior, navigation, and the interpretation of interface elements. iOS accessibility APIs: Apply iOS Accessibility APIs and SwiftUI Accessibility capabilities to improve accessibility throughout the application. Dynamic Type and scalable interfaces: Implement Dynamic Type and scalable font sizes to ensure content remains readable and usable across different text-size preferences. Accessibility attributes: Configure and optimize accessibility labels, traits, values, and actions so that assistive technologies can accurately interpret and interact with interface components. Accessibility focus management: Implement and refine accessibility focus behavior to support intuitive navigation and predictable interactions for users relying on assistive technologies. Accessibility testing and quality assurance: Conduct hands-on accessibility testing, particularly with VoiceOver, to identify, investigate, and resolve accessibility-related defects. Standards compliance: Validate accessibility implementations against relevant guidelines, including WCAG 2.1 and WCAG 2.2, and contribute to continuous improvements in inclusive design. Cross-functional collaboration: Work with relevant technical stakeholders to troubleshoot issues, share expertise, and deliver accessible, maintainable, and user-centered mobile solutions. Requirements At least 5 years of professional experience in native iOS application development. Strong practical expertise in Swift and a solid understanding of native iOS development principles. Commercial experience developing and maintaining applications using SwiftUI and/or UIKit. Extensive hands-on experience implementing accessibility features in native iOS applications. Strong practical knowledge of VoiceOver, including testing and optimizing screen-reader navigation and interactions. Experience working with iOS Accessibility APIs and SwiftUI Accessibility features. Demonstrated experience implementing Dynamic Type and scalable font sizes to accommodate different accessibility preferences. Practical experience configuring and optimizing accessibility labels, traits, values, and actions. Experience implementing and troubleshooting accessibility focus management in native iOS interfaces. Proven ability to conduct accessibility testing, identify usability barriers, and implement effective technical solutions. Knowledge of accessibility standards and guidelines, ideally including WCAG 2.1 and WCAG 2.2. Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality software. Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and collaborate effectively with distributed, international teams. Good English communication skills, both written and verbal. A proactive, quality-focused mindset and the ability to work independently in a remote development environment. Benefits Fully remote work: Work remotely with the flexibility to manage your work from your preferred location anywhere. Competitive compensation: Receive a solid, competitive salary aligned with your skills and experience. International projects: Collaborate in a multinational environment and contribute to projects with an international scope. Com

jobs.title: App Security Expert
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Design and implement purpose-built application fixtures containing representative security vulnerabilities or secure implementations, with a focus on OWASP risks affecting large language model applications. Develop realistic test scenarios addressing critical LLM security concerns, including sensitive information disclosure, excessive agency, and related application security weaknesses. jobs.title: In-House Content Creator (Freelance)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As an In-House Content Creator, you will be responsible for developing creative content that supports brand objectives and digital marketing campaigns. You will work closely with internal collaborators to bring ideas to life, maintain quality standards, and ensure that content resonates with its intended audience. Your main responsibilities will include: Develop high-quality, engaging content aligned with brand voice, creative direction, and campaign objectives. Collaborate with internal teams to brainstorm ideas, develop concepts, and execute creative projects. Produce multimedia content, including written copy, images, and short-form videos, according to project needs. Create content tailored to digital platforms and social media channels. Stay informed about social media trends, emerging formats, and creative best practices to develop relevant content. Adapt content based on feedback and revise deliverables to meet creative expectations. Maintain consistent quality across all content and ensure deliverables meet agreed deadlines. Manage your workload independently and communicate effectively with team members in a remote working environment. Requirements: The ideal candidate is a creative, adaptable, and organised professional with experience producing engaging digital content and a strong understanding of social media platforms. You should be comfortable working independently, managing deadlines, and using creative tools to turn ideas into effective content. The following qualifications and skills are expected: Proven experience in content creation or a similar role. A portfolio or examples demonstrating your creative abilities, storytelling skills, and content production experience. Required: Include links to your TikTok and Instagram profiles or other relevant social media channels in your CV. Strong creative thinking, storytelling, and communication skills. Proficiency with content creation tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, or equivalent software. Familiarity with social media platforms, current trends, and digital content formats. Ability to create engaging content across different formats, including text, images, and short-form videos. Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and meet deadlines in a remote environment. Openness to feedback and the ability to adapt creative work quickly to changing requirements. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail. Benefits: Fully remote work, with the flexibility to work from anywhere. Competitive freelance rates. Opportunity to collaborate with a dynamic and creative team. Exposure to diverse creative projects and digital advertising campaigns. Flexible working arrangements suited to independent contractors.

Work with Java frameworks such as Spring, Spring Boot, Hibernate, or Struts to support application development and maintainability. Integrate RESTful web services and APIs to enable reliable communication between application components. Use JavaScript, CSS, and related web technologies to enhance application functionality and user interfaces. Work with integrated development environments such as IntelliJ IDEA, Eclipse, or NetBeans to develop, debug, and maintain software. Collaborate with senior team members, follow technical instructions, and contribute to team objectives. Apply good development practices, maintain code quality, and support testing and troubleshooting activities. Follow established schedules, project guidelines, and professional standards, demonstrating honesty, integrity, and accountability. Candidates should demonstrate strong technical fundamentals, a willingness to learn, and the discipline to follow established development processes. The following qualifications and skills are required or preferred: At least 2.5 years of relevant professional development experience. Strong knowledge of Core Java and Java SE, including object-oriented programming principles. Familiarity with Java 8 or later features, including lambda expressions and streams. Required: Hands-on experience with JSP and Servlets for web application development. Understanding of the MVC design pattern. Experience with at least one Java framework, such as Spring, Spring Boot, Hibernate, or Struts. Required: Practical experience developing and deploying desktop and web-based applications for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Knowledge of RESTful web services and APIs. Basic to intermediate knowledge of JavaScript and a foundational understanding of CSS. Experience with an IDE such as IntelliJ IDEA, Eclipse, or NetBeans, with IntelliJ IDEA preferred. Familiarity with modern JavaScript frameworks or libraries such as React, Angular, or Vue.js is an advantage. Knowledge of SQL databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle, and ORM tools such as Hibernate, is preferred. Experience with Git and platforms such as GitHub or Bitbucket is an advantage. Good teamwork skills, a strong sense of responsibility, honesty, integrity, and the ability to follow instructions from senior team members. jobs.title: Senior Android Developer (Kotlin)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As a Senior Android Developer, you will be responsible for developing robust native Android applications while ensuring that accessibility is integrated throughout the development lifecycle.
