Validate accessibility implementations against relevant standards and support compliance with WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 guidelines. Requirements: The ideal candidate is an experienced Android developer with strong Kotlin skills and substantial hands-on expertise in mobile accessibility. You should be comfortable developing native applications, identifying accessibility challenges, and delivering practical solutions that improve the user experience. The following qualifications and skills are required: At least 5 years of professional experience in native Android development. Strong practical knowledge of Kotlin. Commercial experience with Jetpack Compose and/or Android Views. Extensive hands-on experience implementing accessibility features in native Android applications. Strong practical experience using TalkBack. Experience with Android Accessibility APIs and/or Compose Semantics. Proven experience implementing content descriptions, accessibility roles and states, and accessibility focus management. Experience supporting scalable text, accessible font sizes, optimised touch targets, and accessible navigation. Practical experience conducting accessibility testing, particularly with TalkBack. Knowledge of accessibility standards, ideally including WCAG 2.1 and WCAG 2.2. Good English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in an international team. Benefits: Fully remote work model, offering flexibility in your work environment. Competitive salary. Opportunity to work in a multinational environment on international projects. jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As a Senior Android Developer, you will be responsible for developing robust native Android applications while ensuring that accessibility is integrated throughout the development lifecycle. Your main responsibilities will include: Develop and maintain native Android applications using Kotlin, implementing new features and enhancing existing functionality. Build and improve application components using Jetpack Compose and/or traditional Android Views. Ensure application stability, performance, maintainability, and high code quality. Implement and optimise accessibility features to deliver inclusive mobile experiences. Ensure compatibility with TalkBack and leverage Android Accessibility APIs and Compose Semantics. Configure and improve content descriptions, accessibility roles, and states to support assistive technologies. Manage accessibility focus and navigation to provide a consistent and intuitive user experience. Support scalable text, accessible font sizes, and appropriately sized touch targets. Conduct accessibility testing, particularly with TalkBack, to identify and resolve usability issues. Validate accessibility implementations against relevant standards and support compliance with WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 guidelines. Requirements: The ideal candidate is an experienced Android developer with strong Kotlin skills and substantial hands-on expertise in mobile accessibility. You should be comfortable developing native applications, identifying accessibility challenges, and delivering practical solutions that improve the user experience. The following qualifications and skills are required: At least 5 years of professional experience in native Android development. Strong practical knowledge of Kotlin. Commercial experience with Jetpack Compose and/or Android Views. Extensive hands-on experience implementing accessibility features in native Android applications. Strong practical experience using TalkBack. Experience with Android Accessibility APIs and/or Compose Semantics. Proven experience implementing content descriptions, accessibility roles and states, and accessibility focus management. Experience supporting scalable text, accessible font sizes, optimised touch targets, and accessible navigation. Practical experience conducting accessibility testing, particularly with TalkBack. Knowledge of accessibility standards, ideally including WCAG 2.1 and WCAG 2.2. Good English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in an international team. Benefits: Fully remote work model, offering flexibility in your work environment. Competitive salary. Opportunity to work in a multinational environment on international projects. Comprehensive healthcare coverage. Long-term business-to-business (B2B) contract. Stable pipeline of projects, providing opportunities for continued collaboration and professional development.

jobs.title: Mid/Senior AI LLM Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Fine-tune and optimize existing open-weight large language models to improve conversational quality, response accuracy, consistency, and personalization. Prepare, curate, and enhance training datasets to support effective model learning, reduce undesirable outputs, and improve the relevance and naturalness of generated responses. Design and implement evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and testing methodologies to measure model quality, identify weaknesses, and validate improvements. Improve conversational memory, personality consistency, and the ability of models to maintain coherent, context-aware interactions over extended conversations. Develop multilingual conversational capabilities and support interactions involving multiple characters, ensuring natural and consistent behavior across different scenarios. Investigate model failures and performance limitations, adjusting training data, prompts, model configurations, and response filters to address identified issues. Conduct GPU-based training and fine-tuning experiments, troubleshoot infrastructure and performance issues, and optimize training workflows for efficiency and reliability. Apply modern model adaptation and alignment techniques, including supervised fine-tuning, LoRA, QLoRA, and preference-based optimization methods where appropriate. Deploy improved models into production environments, monitor their performance, analyze user-facing outcomes, and implement iterative refinements based on evaluation results. Collaborate with AI engineering, product, web development, and DevOps teams to integrate model improvements into consumer-facing applications and align technical work with product objectives. Work with sensitive conversational use cases and moderation requirements, balancing model behavior, user experience, and applicable content policies. Requirements: Proven hands-on experience fine-tuning open-weight large language models and deploying models into production environments. Strong Python programming skills, including experience developing, testing, and maintaining machine-learning workflows. Practical experience with PyTorch and Hugging Face or comparable machine-learning frameworks and model development tools. Experience with model training and adaptation techniques such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), and Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA). Familiarity with preference-based training and alignment techniques, such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) or Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Experience preparing and managing training datasets, improving data quality, and developing evaluation frameworks to assess model behavior and output quality. Practical experience with GPU-based model training, performance optimization, and debugging training-related technical issues. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate model behavior, identify root causes, design experiments, and demonstrate measurable improvements. Understanding of the challenges involved in deploying and maintaining LLM-powered applications, including response quality, consistency, inference performance, and ongoing monitoring. Experience working on consumer-facing AI products, with an understanding of how model quality and conversational behavior affect user experience. Comfort working with minimally restricted or uncensored AI models, including explicit adult or NSFW content and sensitive moderation material, while applying appropriate safeguards and content-handling practices. Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage experiments effectively, document findings, and collaborate with cross-functional teams. Strong communication skills, attention to detail, and a continuous-learning mindset, with the ability to translate experimental results into practical product improvements. jobs.title: Deal Sourcing Partner AI, Healthcare & MedTech
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Identify promising companies in AI, Healthcare, MedTech, HealthTech, Life Sciences, Biotech, Diagnostics, and Medical Devices with financing needs or strategic capital requirements. Where appropriate, support promising opportunities through the process of securing a formal mandate. Maintain strong relationships with sector stakeholders to generate recurring opportunities and support the development of a long-term strategic partnership. jobs.title: Customer Experience Manager
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: You will apply established CX practices to complex business challenges, helping cross-functional teams understand customer needs, prioritize improvements, and measure their impact. Your responsibilities will include: Apply and evolve CX practices: Use established methodologies, tools, templates, and standards consistently across initiatives. Adapt the level of rigor to each project's complexity, risk, scale, and customer impact, and recommend practical improvements to CX tools and processes based on experience. Conduct customer and stakeholder research: Define research objectives and select appropriate qualitative, survey-based, operational, and existing-data inputs. Conduct customer and employee interviews, stakeholder interviews, focus groups, observations, and other research activities as needed. Generate actionable insights: Develop unbiased research guides and materials, synthesize findings into meaningful themes, identify customer pain points and unmet needs, and connect feedback with operational data and business context to uncover root causes. Develop customer experience improvements: Lead current-state and future-state journey mapping, service blueprinting, and process mapping to clarify customer needs, internal dependencies, handoffs, and ownership. Facilitate solution design and prioritization: Lead design-thinking workshops, ideation sessions, and prioritization exercises. Help teams identify the process, technology, policy, data, governance, communication, and role changes needed to address experience gaps. Build actionable roadmaps: Prioritize improvement opportunities according to customer impact, business value, risk, effort, and feasibility, translating findings into clear recommendations, requirements, and next steps. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration: Design and lead workshops with senior leaders, product teams, technical specialists, operational teams, and frontline employees. Create structure in ambiguous situations, manage competing viewpoints, and guide participants toward decisions and shared ownership. Influence stakeholders: Build credibility across teams and organizational levels, communicate CX concepts in language relevant to different audiences, and balance customer expectations with operational and commercial realities. Communicate findings effectively: Prepare concise, executive-ready reports, presentations, and recommendations that make complex issues understandable without losing important insights. Measure customer and business outcomes: Define appropriate experience, operational, and business measures; establish baselines; monitor progress; and assess whether improvements deliver the intended results. Demonstrate financial value: Connect experience challenges and improvements to relevant outcomes such as productivity, rework, cost-to-serve, adoption, risk, retention, revenue, and margin. Help teams develop practical business cases for prioritized initiatives. Support implementation and continuous improvement: Stay engaged throughout implementation to help preserve the intended customer outcomes while delivery ownership remains with the accountable business or product team. Support customer listening and closed-loop feedback mechanisms that turn recurring issues into prioritized improvements. Requirements: The ideal candidate is an experienced CX practitioner who combines strong research and analytical capabilities with structured problem-solving, excellent facilitation, and a clear understanding of business outcomes. The role requires the ability to lead complex initiatives independently and influence stakeholders across functions. Qualifications include: At least five years of professional experience in Customer Experience. A bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of relevant professional experience, training, and demonstrated capability. Proven experience independently leading customer research, journey mapping, experience design, and insight-driven impro

jobs.title: Legal Operations Specialist
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: You will support the legal and operational needs of an international organization by managing agreements, assisting with compliance activities, and ensuring continuity of legal support across regions. Draft, review, and standardize commercial agreements, including sponsorship, vendor, and partnership contracts. Support compliance procedures by coordinating documentation, conducting initial checks, and assisting with due diligence processes. Provide timely legal guidance and practical insights to operational teams and executive stakeholders across different regions. Maintain an organized digital repository of legal templates, executed contracts, and related documentation, ensuring records remain accurate and accessible. Coordinate with external legal counsel when specialized advice or additional legal support is required. Support cross-border contractual processes and help ensure that agreements and documentation meet relevant legal and compliance requirements. Participate in daily handovers and regional coverage rotations to maintain continuity of legal support across time zones. Identify opportunities to improve contract workflows, documentation standards, and legal operations processes. Collaborate with international colleagues to ensure legal requests are handled efficiently and business activities remain well supported. Requirements: The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in corporate or commercial law, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to manage legal workflows independently in an international environment. A law degree and at least 3 years of professional experience in corporate law, commercial law, or a related legal field. Strong understanding of international commercial contracts, cross-border transactions, and compliance requirements. Demonstrated experience drafting, reviewing, and managing agreements with vendors, sponsors, business partners, or other commercial stakeholders. Excellent English proficiency at C1 level or above, with the ability to communicate legal information clearly and professionally. Additional language skills are an advantage. Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate, well-organized legal documentation. Responsive, proactive, and comfortable working autonomously while managing multiple priorities. Effective communication and coordination skills when working with executive teams, operational stakeholders, and external legal counsel. Ability to collaborate across time zones and maintain clear handovers in a globally distributed team. Previous experience in remote or international working environments is preferred. Location requirement: Candidates must currently reside in Poland, the Philippines, or Latin America to be considered for this position. Benefits: Monthly compensation of $2,500–$2,800 USD, depending on experience. Fully remote work arrangement. Flexible collaboration with an international team across multiple regions. Exposure to international business operations, private markets, and investment structures. Opportunities for professional development, leadership responsibilities, and legal process optimization.

jobs.title: AI Tooling Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: You will help develop and maintain an internal AI platform, combining agent development, systems integration, production engineering, and continuous optimization to deliver practical tools that improve how teams work. Collaborate with the Principal Engineer to design, develop, and deploy new platform capabilities, taking ownership from initial design through production release. Integrate internal systems and SaaS applications by connecting APIs and data sources, defining shared data models, and implementing appropriate access permissions. Build AI agents and supporting tools, including MCP servers that enable agents across the organization to interact with internal systems and retrieve relevant context. Design and improve retrieval workflows, tool calling, embeddings, prompts, and context management to deliver accurate and useful AI-generated responses. Establish and maintain AI quality standards through evaluation datasets, benchmarks, regression testing, tracing, and observability. Monitor performance indicators, including cost per answer and token usage, and optimize models, prompts, and workflows for efficiency and reliability. Troubleshoot production issues, incorporate user feedback, and continuously improve the platform based on real-world usage. Turn proofs of concept into secure, scalable cloud applications with appropriate infrastructure, deployment processes, and identity and access controls. Use AI coding agents as a core part of the development workflow while maintaining code quality through clear specifications, automated tests, reviews, and sound engineering practices. Contribute to company-wide AI tooling initiatives, including evaluating and standardizing internal AI tools, tracking usage and costs, and defining standards for AI-generated applications. Support other teams in adopting and building on the platform, helping them develop effective AI-powered workflows and internal applications. Engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders across the organization to understand their needs, prioritize improvements, and communicate solutions clearly. Requirements: The ideal candidate is a hands-on software engineer with practical experience delivering AI agents to production, a strong understanding of modern AI development frameworks, and the ability to build secure, reliable internal tools. At least 3 years of experience building and shipping production software, primarily using Python and relational databases. Proven experience building and deploying at least one production AI agent with LangGraph that is used by real users. Practical expertise in agent development, including tool calling, retrieval and embeddings, prompt engineering, and context design. Hands-on experience with LLM APIs from major providers, including token management and cost optimization. Experience working with MCP or comparable tool protocols, both as a server and as a client. Strong understanding of AI evaluation methodologies, including test datasets, LLM-as-judge approaches, regression testing, and performance monitoring. Familiarity with tracing and observability tools such as Langfuse or equivalent solutions. Experience integrating APIs and data sources, including SaaS applications, SQL databases, and data warehouses. Practical experience with cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or both, including containers, managed databases, identity and access management, and CI/CD pipelines. Daily use of AI coding agents, with the ability to validate their output and maintain high standards of software quality. Strong understanding of security principles, identity management, permissions, and least-privilege access controls. Experience with version control and collaborative development tools such as GitHub or Bitbucket. Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Desired Skills: Fam

jobs.title: Founding CTO (AI/ML / Data Product)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As a founding technology leader, you will drive the technical and product development of an AI-powered B2B venture, balancing feasibility, customer needs, and commercial potential throughout the 12-week program. Identify and validate a B2B problem where AI can deliver measurable value through time savings, cost reduction, or risk mitigation. Define a product-focused MVP that addresses a clear customer need rather than prioritizing model complexity for its own sake. Design the data strategy, including data collection, labeling, evaluation, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Architect and deliver a reliable prototype or MVP, incorporating APIs, data pipelines, appropriate safeguards, and feedback loops. Establish foundational production practices for model deployment, monitoring, reliability, and ongoing performance evaluation. Iterate on the product based on validation results, user feedback, and evolving business requirements. Develop a compelling technical and product narrative for potential investors, explaining the venture's competitive advantage, data strategy, and product roadmap. Collaborate with co-founders, mentors, and other startup participants to refine the business concept and accelerate execution. Dedicate approximately 10–12 hours per week to building, validating, and improving the venture over the 12-week sprint. Requirements: The ideal candidate is an experienced software engineer with strong AI/ML or data product expertise, a product-oriented mindset, and the ambition to take ownership of a new business venture. At least 7 years of experience in software engineering, with substantial exposure to AI/ML or data-driven products. Demonstrated experience deploying software, machine learning models, or data products into production environments. Understanding of MLOps fundamentals, including deployment, monitoring, reliability, and performance evaluation. Ability to design practical AI and data solutions that address real business problems and deliver measurable outcomes. Strong product judgment, with the ability to define MVP scope, prioritize essential functionality, and determine when a solution is ready for validation. Experience or familiarity with APIs, data pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and production-ready system design. An entrepreneurial mindset, with a genuine desire to build a company, take ownership of technical decisions, and participate in the potential upside of a venture. Ability to work independently, make decisions under uncertainty, and move quickly from problem discovery to product execution. Willingness to commit approximately 10–12 hours per week for 12 weeks. Interest in collaborating with co-founders, engaging with mentors, and developing an investor-ready vision for an AI-powered B2B business. Benefits: A structured, 12-week startup sprint to progress from problem discovery to MVP development, validation, and iteration. Fully remote participation with an international community of founders and technology professionals. Weekly accountability sessions and a consistent execution cadence to maintain momentum and focus. Access to a network of more than 500 mentors specializing in B2B businesses, product development, go-to-market strategy, and fundraising. Connections to a global alumni network of more than 440 startups across over 40 countries, offering opportunities for learning, collaboration, and introductions. A practical CTO toolkit for AI ventures, covering product scoping, model evaluation, deployment, and the development of a defensible competitive advantage. The opportunity to become a co-founder or join a founding team and build an AI-powered business with long-term growth potential. A participation fee is required after acceptance to secure commitment to the cohort.

jobs.title: Head of Customer Success - Loyalty and Partner Platforms (B2B)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: You will take full ownership of the customer experience, ensuring smooth onboarding, strong partner relationships, and continuous improvement across the customer lifecycle while using AI to enhance operational efficiency. Own the end-to-end onboarding process for new B2B customers, from initial setup through integration, launch, and ongoing success management. Guide partners through the launch checklist, ensuring timely completion of integration, balance top-ups, platform listings, and communication reviews. Manage operational relationships with active customers, serving as their primary point of contact and ensuring they maximize the value of their loyalty partnerships. Collaborate with the sales team to align customer success strategies, establish performance indicators, and support customer growth. Improve customer visibility and campaign performance across relevant touchpoints within partner cross-media channels. Ensure customer communications, campaign materials, and visual assets comply with brand standards and applicable requirements. Maintain a high-quality CRM environment in HubSpot or a comparable platform, leveraging AI to log interactions, enrich contact information, flag outdated records, and maintain accurate pipelines. Conduct regular customer reviews, analyze performance data, and identify opportunities to improve engagement, campaign effectiveness, and customer outcomes. Manage customer issues and feedback loops, using AI to categorize support tickets, draft initial responses, recommend relevant knowledge-base resources, and accelerate resolution. Use AI tools to prepare asynchronous updates, summarize meetings, document decisions, and maintain alignment across distributed teams. Build and refine customer success processes, establishing scalable practices that support the long-term development of the function. Requirements: The ideal candidate combines extensive customer success or account management experience with strong technical understanding, practical AI automation skills, and a consultative approach to customer relationships. Fluency in both German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills. At least 5 years of experience in customer success, account management, or partner onboarding within the loyalty, SaaS, or payments industries. Proven ability to manage customer relationships throughout onboarding, implementation, launch, and ongoing engagement. Proficiency with AI tools such as Claude to design workflows, build automations, and improve operational processes. Good understanding of digital integrations, including API connections, web links, voucher uploads, and campaign dashboards. Hands-on experience with HubSpot or comparable CRM platforms, including data management and pipeline optimization. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple customer projects and deadlines simultaneously. Empathetic, consultative, and solution-oriented communication skills, with the ability to combine human judgment and AI-generated insights. Comfort working across teams, time zones, and asynchronous communication channels in a remote environment. A proactive, ownership-driven mindset and the motivation to establish, develop, and continuously improve a customer success function. Benefits: Fully remote work with a worldwide team. Competitive monthly salary package. Equity participation and qiibee tokens (QBX), offering a share in the company's success. Permanent, full-time employment with a 40-hour workweek. 24 days of annual leave. Opportunity to shape and lead the customer success function as its first dedicated hire. Fast-paced, international startup environment focused on innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth. AI-first working culture that uses automation to reduce repetitive tasks and enable teams to focus on meaningful customer relationships.

jobs.title: System Administrator I
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a System Administrator I based in India. As a System Administrator I, you will play a key role in delivering reliable, high-quality IT support to clients in a remote-first environment. You will troubleshoot and resolve a wide range of technical issues across operating systems, servers, business applications, cloud services, and network infrastructure. Working closely with technical teams, you will help maintain secure, stable, and efficient IT environments while ensuring an excellent client experience. You will also support Microsoft 365 administration, virtualization technologies, and endpoint security, contributing to the smooth operation of client systems. This role offers the opportunity to strengthen your technical expertise, take ownership of complex support requests, and assist other technicians with troubleshooting and escalations. Join a collaborative, service-oriented team that values continuous learning, accountability, and professional development. Accountabilities: Provide technical support and troubleshooting: Independently diagnose and resolve workstation operating system issues across Windows and macOS, printer problems, standard business applications, and other common technical challenges. Manage server environments: Troubleshoot and maintain server infrastructure running Windows Server 2016 through 2025, helping ensure system availability, reliability, and performance. Administer Microsoft 365 and cloud services: Resolve Microsoft 365 administration issues and support Microsoft Entra ID, Azure environments, Active Directory, and related identity and access management services. Support virtualization technologies: Maintain and troubleshoot virtualized environments using VMware and Hyper-V to support stable and efficient IT operations. Resolve application issues: Provide support for standard office software and line-of-business applications, including Sage ERP and QuickBooks, coordinating with software vendors when specialized assistance is required. Maintain network connectivity: Troubleshoot basic and intermediate networking issues involving firewalls, switches, network architecture, and connectivity. Protect systems and data: Support backup software, endpoint cybersecurity solutions, mobile devices, and other tools that help maintain secure and resilient client environments. Assist and guide technical teams: Act as an escalation point for technicians, sharing technical knowledge and helping resolve issues that require additional expertise. Deliver excellent client service: Maintain clear, professional communication, document technical work accurately, and contribute to customer satisfaction and service quality. Meet service performance targets: Monitor and improve key performance indicators, including customer satisfaction (CSAT), quality scores, utilization, average time per ticket, and first-touch resolution. Provide scheduled on-call support: Participate in a rotation to deliver after-hours and weekend technical support for onsite and remote operations. Maintain professional readiness: Complete required training and certifications, follow established procedures, and contribute to a collaborative, client-focused team culture. Requirements Relevant IT experience: At least three years of professional experience in IT support, systems administration, or a related technical role. Operating system expertise: Hands-on experience troubleshooting and supporting both Windows and macOS environments. Windows Server administration: Practical experience supporting Windows Server versions 2016 through 2025, including common server administration and troubleshooting tasks. Virtualization knowledge: Experience managing and troubleshooting VMware and Hyper-V virtualization environments. Cloud and identity administration: Experience supporting Microsoft Azure and proficiency with the Microsoft Entr

jobs.title: Director, Product-Led Growth
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Own product-led revenue growth: Define and execute the product-led growth strategy, taking full accountability for ARR generated through self-service experiences, from initial signup to paid conversion, expansion, and retention. Drive acquisition and commercial performance: Develop scalable growth programs, establish measurable revenue and user acquisition targets, and accelerate adoption across key international markets. Align cross-functional teams: Partner with Marketing, Product Management, Engineering, and Sales to translate product strategy into measurable customer outcomes and sustainable business growth. Optimize conversion and monetization: Identify and implement in-product monetization opportunities, improve onboarding and self-service conversion funnels, and strengthen product-led sales handoffs for enterprise customers. Improve customer engagement and retention: Use behavioral analytics, customer intent data, churn indicators, and customer satisfaction metrics to refine the user experience, increase lifetime value, and improve retention. Build a data-driven growth culture: Establish performance metrics, test growth hypotheses, analyze results, and continuously improve acquisition, activation, conversion, and expansion strategies. Support product innovation: Collaborate with product leaders to align platform capabilities with customer needs, developer workflows, and emerging opportunities in AI-assisted software development. Requirements Proven product-led growth leadership: Significant experience as a Senior Product Manager, Director, or in a comparable leadership role within a SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or developer-focused technology business operating primarily through a product-led model. Direct revenue accountability: Demonstrated ownership of revenue targets and commercial outcomes, including ARR growth, customer acquisition, freemium-to-paid conversion, and retention. Strategic and commercial expertise: Ability to translate complex technical products into accessible self-service experiences that deliver measurable customer and business value. Cross-functional leadership: A strong track record of leading growth initiatives across Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Sales, with the ability to align diverse stakeholders around shared objectives. Advanced growth analytics skills: Hands-on experience with funnel optimization, user activation, conversion analysis, experimentation, monetization strategies, and customer retention metrics. Technical fluency: Practical understanding of developer workflows, cloud infrastructure, and modern software development environments, including the evolving role of AI-assisted development tools. Strong communication and leadership: Excellent analytical thinking, strategic judgment, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence teams in a distributed, international environment. Additional advantages: Experience managing both product-led growth (PLG) and product-led sales (PLS), familiarity with PaaS, IaaS, DevOps, or developer platforms, and a proven ability to scale product-led revenue across global, remote-first teams. Remote-work readiness: Ability to work effectively in a multicultural, distributed environment and collaborate across functions, time zones, and geographic markets. Benefits Flexible paid time off: Take time away from work to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. Healthcare coverage: Comprehensive healthcare benefits in eligible locations, including the UK, Canada, France, Spain, and the United States. Equity participation: Company stock options that provide an opportunity to share in the company's long-term success. Professional development: Dedicated budget for learning, training, and career growth. Home office support: Equipment budget to create a productive and comfortable remote workspace. jobs.title: Counsel, Offboarding & Litigation
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Lead end-to-end offboarding, pre-litigation, and litigation matters across EMEA, including for-cause terminations, redundancies, collective dismissals, mutual separations, and other contentious employment exits. Manage disciplinary and consultation processes, statutory filings, and employment disputes, ensuring compliance with applicable labor laws and procedural requirements in each jurisdiction. Conduct case intake, fact-finding, and legal risk assessments for employee relations matters, guiding internal stakeholders and clients through statutory procedures from initial notice to final settlement and clearance. Lead or support disciplinary hearings, conciliation, mediation, arbitration, and employment litigation proceedings, advising on appropriate disciplinary measures and resolution strategies. Draft and review termination notices, separation agreements, legal submissions, position statements, and supporting evidence to ensure accuracy, legal defensibility, and alignment with local legislation and jurisprudence. Evaluate litigation exposure, including potential reinstatement, back pay, statutory and compensatory damages, and settlement costs, while developing hearing strategies and providing commercially informed updates to stakeholders. Serve as the primary point of contact for external legal counsel, overseeing case assignments, defining scopes of work, negotiating fees and timelines, and reviewing the quality of legal deliverables. Collaborate with HR Advisory, Customer Success, Sales, Payroll, Onboarding, and Legal teams to strengthen offboarding frameworks, resolve escalations, and improve client outcomes. Partner with product teams to review offboarding, disciplinary, and termination workflows, validate their compliance with local employment laws, and identify regulatory changes requiring product or system updates. Contribute to cross-functional legal initiatives, regional compliance projects, process automation, and other strategic matters that support operational efficiency and risk reduction. Requirements A law degree (JD, LLB, or equivalent) and active admission to the Bar or an equivalent qualifying legal body in an applicable EMEA jurisdiction, in good standing. Between 6 and 10 years of post-qualification experience in employment law within EMEA, including substantial hands-on experience leading employment agency proceedings, tribunal cases, arbitrations, and disciplinary or grievance hearings. A demonstrated employment litigation track record, including drafting legal submissions and pleadings, preparing witnesses, conducting hearing advocacy, and evaluating potential reinstatement, back pay, and damages exposure. Strong working knowledge of EMEA employment legislation, particularly termination procedures, statutory due process, and unfair or wrongful dismissal. Familiarity with employment law and offboarding requirements across multiple EMEA jurisdictions, with the ability to quickly understand and apply regulations in new markets. Proven experience managing employee lifecycle matters, including performance improvement plans (PIPs), disciplinary actions, workplace investigations, dismissals for cause, and redundancy processes. Strong expertise in instructing and managing external legal counsel, including defining case scope, negotiating fees, managing deadlines, and reviewing legal work for quality and effectiveness. Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across Product, Operations, HR, and commercial teams while communicating confidently with clients and business partners. Outstanding written and verbal English communication skills, combined with sound legal judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to translate complex legal issues into clear, practical business guidance. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Manager based in Romania. As a Product Manager, you will help improve the performance, reliability, and reach of a technology product operating in the blockchain and decentralized finance ecosystem. You will take ownership of execution quality, ensuring that liquidity sources perform as expected and transactions meet defined success standards. You will also lead the integration of new liquidity providers and ecosystems, expanding product capabilities and market coverage. Working closely with engineering, business development, quality assurance, and data teams, you will turn complex technical challenges into clear, actionable product priorities. You will use analytics, monitoring, and experimentation to identify issues, guide decisions, and continuously improve product performance. The role offers the opportunity to influence a technically sophisticated product within a collaborative, international, and remote-first environment. This position is open to candidates based in Europe, with a strong emphasis on ownership, continuous learning, and cross-functional collaboration. Accountabilities: Own execution quality across the aggregation product, defining performance standards and developing the metrics, monitoring processes, and features needed to improve transaction success rates. Lead the end-to-end onboarding of new liquidity sources and ecosystems, from identifying opportunities and assessing requirements to coordinating implementation and launch. Collaborate closely with the technical lead to translate business objectives and technical requirements into clear product specifications, well-defined engineering tickets, and actionable development priorities. Monitor API behavior, tool performance, and transaction outcomes to identify anomalies, investigate issues, and address potential problems before they affect partners or end users. Build and maintain strong relationships with external partners, including decentralized exchanges and other liquidity providers, ensuring effective communication and successful integrations. Work cross-functionally with business development, quality assurance, and data teams to align priorities, resolve issues, and identify opportunities for continuous product improvement. Analyze product performance data to identify trends, evaluate execution quality, and translate insights into measurable product decisions. Take ownership of product initiatives from discovery through delivery, maintaining a high standard of execution, attention to detail, and accountability. Contribute to a collaborative team culture that values diverse perspectives, thoughtful decision-making, continuous improvement, and learning from experimentation. Requirements Ideally 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager, with a proven track record of delivering and improving products in technically complex environments. Mandatory blockchain experience, ideally gained within a blockchain company, with a solid understanding of the ecosystem and its technical and operational challenges. Strong analytical and data-driven thinking, with the ability to interpret performance data, identify patterns, investigate issues, and translate findings into actionable product decisions. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to work confidently with external partners such as decentralized exchanges. Ability to translate complex technical problems into clear requirements, practical solutions, and well-structured tasks for engineering teams. Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive approach to identifying inconsistencies, investigating unexpected behavior, and maintaining product quality. jobs.title: Senior Product Designer - Growth/Website | Deel
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Own the end-to-end design and optimization of website pages and landing pages, proactively identifying conversion opportunities and taking initiatives from concept to launch. Define clear problem statements, establish success metrics, develop design hypotheses, and create prototypes to support rapid experimentation. Plan, execute, and iterate on A/B tests, using results and user insights to refine experiences and improve conversion performance. Deliver high-quality visual designs and intuitive user interfaces while maintaining brand consistency and adhering to established design systems. Collaborate with growth, performance marketing, sales, and product marketing teams to understand business objectives and translate customer needs into effective website experiences. Develop compelling visual and written storytelling to communicate new products, features, launches, and promotional offers. Partner with growth product managers, engineers, data analysts, and lifecycle marketers to plan, implement, and evaluate experiments. Design high-performing landing pages that support new product and feature launches in collaboration with product marketing teams. Maintain high standards of design craftsmanship and experimentation, providing constructive feedback and helping other designers grow. Oversee design quality assurance for web experiments and launches, ensuring that the final implementation meets design expectations and business objectives. Requirements At least 8 years of experience in product design, supported by a portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership of website design and landing page projects. Proven experience in conversion rate optimization (CRO), A/B testing, and experimentation, including hypothesis development, test design, statistical significance, and iterative improvement. Excellent UI and visual design skills, with a portfolio showcasing polished, user-focused web experiences that deliver measurable conversion results. A strong growth mindset, with a commitment to learning from experiments, validating assumptions, and continuously improving outcomes. Excellent storytelling skills and a strong understanding of visual hierarchy, user behavior, and conversion-focused design principles. Proficiency in analytics and experimentation tools such as Amplitude or Google Analytics, with the ability to combine quantitative data and qualitative user insights to inform decisions. Experience managing web experiments and product launches from initial concept through implementation and design quality assurance. Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain design decisions clearly to creative teams and business stakeholders. Experience building, maintaining, and evolving design systems for marketing websites. The ability to work independently, identify opportunities without waiting for detailed briefs, and collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams. Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance speed, experimentation, and high design standards in a fast-paced environment. Benefits Remote-first flexibility: Work remotely within the eligible locations and time zones supported by the role. Equity opportunities: Potential stock grants in a pre-IPO company, subject to role, employment status, and location. Flexible office access: Optional flexible office membership through IWG. Collaborative design culture: Work alongside a talented design team, with opportunities to exchange knowledge, develop your skills, and receive constructive feedback. Meaningful impact: Directly influence the website experience that introduces prospective customers to the business and contributes to growth. Professional development: Gain hands-on experience with high-impact conversion initiatives, rapid experimentation, and cross-functional collaboration in a fast-growing international environment.

jobs.title: Investment Banking AI Research Contributor
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Develop Realistic Financial Modeling Tasks: Create practical Excel assignments based on your professional experience in investment banking, M&A advisory, or corporate development. Tasks may involve extending existing financial models, troubleshooting broken spreadsheets, or building models from detailed briefs. Establish Correct Reference Solutions: Complete each assignment yourself to produce a clear, accurate reference answer that can be used to assess AI-generated outputs. Design Evaluation Criteria: Develop precise, objective, yes-or-no grading rubrics that enable reviewers to consistently evaluate whether an AI model has completed each task correctly. Test AI Model Capabilities: Submit your assignments for evaluation against leading AI models and analyze their performance in realistic financial modeling scenarios. Refine Evaluation Frameworks: When AI models fail to meet expectations, create detailed assessment criteria that identify errors, inaccuracies, and gaps in their outputs. Collaborate with reviewers to validate and finalize your tasks. Prepare High-Quality Supporting Materials: Write clear task briefs and provide the necessary input Excel workbooks. Ensure that all materials are original, human-created, and based on appropriately sanitized real data or publicly available data with its source identified. Maintain Professional and Data Integrity Standards: Ensure that assignments do not contain confidential or proprietary information belonging to any employer, client, or institution. Complete Project Onboarding: Participate in an introductory group walkthrough, submit an original task proposal, and follow the evaluation and review process. Successful approval of the initial task may qualify you to complete additional assignments during the project period. Requirements: Relevant Professional Experience: At least 3 years of experience in investment banking, M&A advisory, or corporate development, with practical exposure to financial analysis and modeling. Advanced Excel and Financial Modeling Skills: Strong hands-on expertise in Excel, including merger models, pro forma financial statements, purchase accounting, precedent transaction analysis, football field valuations, and financial functions. Financial Modeling Accuracy: Ability to build, review, troubleshoot, and extend complex financial models while ensuring numerical accuracy, logical consistency, and professional standards. Analytical and Problem-Solving Abilities: Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify modeling errors, translate complex financial workflows into structured tasks, and define clear criteria for evaluating results. Written Communication: Excellent written English skills, with the ability to produce clear task briefs, detailed instructions, and objective evaluation rubrics. Interest in AI Research: Willingness to learn about AI evaluation methodologies, model testing, and evaluation frameworks, even without prior specialized experience in AI. Independent Working Style: Ability to manage assignments autonomously, meet deadlines, and deliver high-quality work within a flexible, remote environment. Data Confidentiality and Integrity: Commitment to using only appropriately sanitized real-world data or public data with clearly identified sources. All task briefs and input workbooks must be created by a human without AI assistance. Availability: Ability to begin promptly and participate in the initial onboarding process, including a 30-minute group walkthrough and submission of an original task with the required input workbook files. Benefits: Fully Remote Work: Complete assignments from anywhere, without the need to work from a physical office. Flexible Schedule: Organize your work around your own schedule, provided you meet the required task deadlines. jobs.title: Product Owner (Matchmaking)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Own the Post-Purchase Customer Journey: Take end-to-end responsibility for the experience of paying customers, focusing on helping them achieve meaningful matches as quickly as possible. Identify friction points and opportunities to improve activation, engagement, and the time it takes users to experience product value. Optimize Matching and Recommendation Relevance: Improve the relevance and quality of recommendations, ensuring customers receive an appropriate volume of options and develop trust in the suggestions presented to them. Increase Meaningful Engagement: Develop strategies to increase relevant invitations and improve the likelihood that new customers achieve a quality match during their first week on the platform. Drive Conversation Activation: Design and implement engagement mechanisms, including gamification, nudges, and reminders, that encourage users to return to conversations and build stronger connections. Leverage Segmentation and Personalization: Identify the matching parameters that matter most to different customer segments. Use segmentation, personalization, and enriched offer data to improve recommendation quality and overall customer outcomes. Identify Product Growth Opportunities: Analyze product metrics, customer behavior, qualitative feedback, and quantitative research to identify bottlenecks and prioritize opportunities throughout the post-purchase journey. Define Hypotheses and Requirements: Translate insights into clear, testable hypotheses, establish success metrics, and create actionable product requirements that support effective execution. Lead Cross-Functional Delivery: Collaborate closely with engineers, designers, analysts, and data and machine learning specialists to prioritize initiatives, coordinate timelines, and deliver product improvements efficiently. Run Experiments and Measure Results: Plan and execute A/B tests and other product experiments, evaluate performance against defined metrics, and iterate on successful initiatives to maximize impact. Drive Continuous Improvement: Take ownership of outcomes, adapt priorities based on evidence, and continuously refine the customer experience through a balance of data-driven decisions and practical problem-solving. Requirements: Product Management Experience: Proven experience in a B2C product role, with hands-on responsibility for customer experience, customer journey design, activation, onboarding, or first-session optimization. Discovery-Driven Product Expertise: Experience working with products that feature large volumes of offers, listings, or potential connections, where discovery and relevance are central to the customer experience. Matching and Recommendation Systems: Familiarity with search relevance, recommendation engines, matching algorithms, content feeds, or similar systems designed to connect users with relevant options. Segmentation and Personalization: Understanding of customer segmentation, personalization strategies, and data enrichment techniques to improve recommendation quality and user outcomes. Relevant Industry Background: Experience in marketplaces, aggregators, dating or social discovery platforms, real estate, classifieds, large-catalog e-commerce, or other products built around discovery, matching, and recommendations. Product Discovery and Hypothesis Development: Ability to identify customer problems, formulate testable hypotheses, define clear requirements, and translate insights into practical product solutions. Experimentation and Analytical Skills: Experience designing and evaluating A/B tests and other experiments, interpreting product metrics, and using quantitative and qualitative research to validate decisions. Product Delivery and Prioritization: Demonstrated ability to manage product requirements, prioritize initiatives, coordinate delivery, and drive projects from discovery through implementation and evaluation. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Strong communication and collaboration

As a Cloud Platform Engineer, you will design, build, and operate scalable cloud infrastructure that enables AI applications, intelligent agents, and data products to move from prototype to production. You will join a central AI team supporting a major international logistics organization, contributing to cloud-native solutions across multiple countries. With a primary focus on Microsoft Azure and exposure to AWS, you will develop reliable infrastructure, deployment workflows, and observability frameworks that accelerate innovation. You will collaborate with AI engineers, data specialists, and international IT teams to establish secure, automated, and cost-efficient cloud environments. Your work will help streamline infrastructure provisioning, strengthen operational resilience, and enable the adoption of advanced AI-driven solutions at scale. This remote opportunity is ideal for a technically strong engineer who enjoys platform automation, cloud architecture, and solving complex challenges in a collaborative, international environment. jobs.title: Integrated Campaign Manager
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Integrated Campaign Manager based in India. As an Integrated Campaign Manager, you will lead the strategy, development, and execution of multi-channel marketing campaigns designed to generate qualified leads, build sales pipeline, and accelerate revenue growth. Working in a fully remote, international environment, you will collaborate closely with marketing, sales, product marketing, brand, events, and operations teams to create a seamless buyer journey. You will take ownership of campaign planning, channel selection, budget allocation, and performance optimization, ensuring that every initiative contributes to measurable business outcomes. By combining creative messaging with data-driven insights, you will continuously refine campaigns to improve engagement, conversion, and return on investment. You will also explore AI-powered tools and emerging technologies to enhance personalization, streamline workflows, and scale campaign execution. This role is ideal for a strategic, results-oriented B2B marketer who thrives in a collaborative environment and wants to make a direct impact on global business growth. Accountabilities: Develop, execute, and optimize integrated, multi-channel demand generation campaigns to attract new prospects, generate qualified pipeline, and accelerate existing sales opportunities. Design quarterly campaign plans that balance ongoing demand generation programs with high-impact initiatives across the prospect lifecycle, aligning channel selection and budget allocation with pipeline and revenue targets. Manage campaigns across multiple channels, including content syndication, webinars, virtual events, email nurturing, direct mail, referral programs, and product demonstration initiatives. Collaborate with product marketing and brand teams to translate positioning and value propositions into compelling campaign messaging, relevant offers, and engaging content. Develop sales enablement materials, including talk tracks, email templates, and one-pagers, while aligning with business development representatives on follow-up processes to convert campaign engagement into qualified meetings. Coordinate campaign timelines, budgets, resources, and external vendors to ensure efficient execution and measurable return on investment. Work closely with marketing, sales, and operations stakeholders to maintain consistent messaging, clear priorities, and coordinated campaign delivery. Monitor campaign performance through analytics, attribution, and pipeline reporting, using A/B testing and other optimization techniques to improve results. Identify and implement opportunities to leverage AI and emerging technologies for audience research, segmentation, personalization, content development, distribution, reporting, and workflow automation. Conduct campaign retrospectives, translate performance insights into actionable improvements, and develop repeatable processes and playbooks to support scalable growth. Requirements At least six years of experience in B2B integrated marketing, demand generation, growth marketing, or account-based marketing, with substantial ownership of campaign strategy and execution. A proven track record of developing and managing campaigns that contribute directly to pipeline generation, pipeline coverage, and revenue growth rather than focusing exclusively on engagement metrics. Strong understanding of multi-channel marketing strategies, campaign planning, audience segmentation, lead nurturing, and conversion optimization. Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including sales, product marketing, brand, digital marketing, events, and operations. Data-driven mindset with practical knowledge of marketing attribution, campaign analytics, pipeline measurement, performance reporting, and A/B testing. Hands-on experience using AI tools to supp

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: In this role, you will build and improve production-ready AI systems while helping nonprofit partners adopt effective, measurable, and responsible AI practices. Your work will combine hands-on engineering, applied research, experimentation, and collaboration with teams working directly in the field. Design, build, evaluate, deploy, and improve machine learning systems and AI-powered applications for real-world use cases. Contribute to open-source AI evaluation infrastructure and tools that help nonprofit organizations assess and improve their AI products. Work closely with behavioral scientists, researchers, and field teams to identify recurring challenges and translate findings into reusable tools, frameworks, playbooks, and technical publications. Develop rigorous evaluation methods for AI systems, including appropriate datasets, evaluation criteria, and measurable performance improvements. Build and iterate on production-grade LLM applications and agentic systems, improving their reliability, usefulness, and performance for intended users. Release meaningful technical innovations from partner projects as open-source contributions whenever appropriate. Deliver solutions through rapid development and deployment cycles, using experimentation and measurable feedback to guide improvements. Document technical decisions, maintain engineering standards, and ensure AI components remain reliable and maintainable. Monitor developments in applied AI research, assess relevant advances, and test promising approaches in practical settings. Advise and support nonprofit organizations developing generative AI products, helping them adopt effective engineering practices, tools, and workflows. Mentor partner organization staff and help strengthen their internal technical capabilities and responsible AI practices. Contribute to workshops, seminars, and knowledge-sharing initiatives that communicate lessons and best practices from ongoing projects. Conduct site visits to understand operational challenges, observe how AI tools are used, and recommend technical improvements based on direct user needs. Take initiative in identifying problems, defining solutions, and driving projects through implementation and deployment. Requirements: The ideal candidate combines strong machine learning fundamentals with substantial hands-on experience delivering end-user AI products. You should be comfortable moving between research, experimentation, production engineering, and collaboration with nontechnical stakeholders, while maintaining a strong focus on practical impact. Strong foundations in mathematics, deep learning, large language models (LLMs), and modern AI systems. At least 4 years of hands-on machine learning engineering experience, including building, evaluating, and systematically improving at least one end-user-facing product powered by deep learning. Experience limited to integrating model APIs, building internal dashboards, or contributing solely to ML infrastructure does not meet this requirement. At least 1–2 years of experience building LLM-powered applications, including at least one production-grade agent beyond a proof of concept. Practical experience evaluating AI systems, with a strong understanding of dataset design, evaluation methodology, and performance measurement. Proficiency in Python and a willingness to remain deeply involved in hands-on implementation. Fluency in prompting and context engineering for agentic systems, including the ability to determine whether a problem requires improved prompting, a different model, better tools, or changes to the overall pipeline. Experience using AI coding agents to produce high-quality work, with the judgment and accountability to validate outputs and take responsibility for what you ship. Ability to read research papers, assess new ideas, and quickly test relevant approaches through practical experimentation. An experimental mindset, with the ability to reason carefully ab

jobs.title: Security Engineer III - Security Operations
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: You will own key aspects of security detection and response, from developing detection rules and investigating incidents to automating workflows and maintaining audit-ready controls. Plan and deliver end-to-end detection and response initiatives, from creating detection rules to implementing automated response workflows. Build, tune, and maintain security detections across Elastic SIEM and AWS environments, identifying and closing gaps in existing threat coverage. Manage the security investigation queue by triaging alerts, investigating suspicious activity, escalating incidents when necessary, and driving issues toward resolution. Document incident investigations and findings clearly to support follow-up actions, knowledge sharing, and operational consistency. Develop and maintain runbooks and automation workflows using Python and no-code tools such as Zapier or Tines to reduce manual work and accelerate incident response. Make and document risk decisions within your area of responsibility, escalating issues when additional expertise or support is required. Support compliance initiatives by maintaining audit-ready security controls and contributing evidence for frameworks such as SOC 2 and PCI DSS. Use Terraform and Python to build, maintain, and improve the infrastructure supporting security detections and operational tooling. Participate in the on-call rotation for security monitoring and incident response. Continuously improve detection coverage, investigation processes, and response efficiency. Requirements: The ideal candidate has practical experience in security operations and cloud-native threat detection, with strong scripting skills and the ability to investigate incidents independently. You should be comfortable taking ownership of security outcomes while communicating findings and risks clearly. Hands-on experience building, maintaining, and tuning SIEM detections. Experience with Elastic is preferred, while Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, or comparable platforms is also relevant. Practical experience securing AWS environments and implementing cloud-native detection and response capabilities. Proficiency in Python for scripting, automation, and security tooling. Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code technologies. Working knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and its application to threat detection and investigation. Demonstrated experience triaging, investigating, and resolving security incidents. Strong written communication skills, with the ability to document investigations, technical findings, and risk decisions in a clear, structured manner. Ability to work independently, prioritize security issues, and take ownership of assigned responsibilities. Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation for monitoring and incident response. Nice to have: Experience with security orchestration, automation, and response (SOAR) platforms or no-code security automation tools. Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS, SOC 2, or ISO 27001. Experience in fintech, payments, or another regulated industry. Benefits: Remote work: Fully remote working environment within a globally distributed team. Equity: Competitive share options. Paid time off: Flexible holiday policy, with a minimum of 25 days to be taken. Coworking access: Access to coworking spaces across major cities. Team events: Workations and an annual company retreat. Equipment: High-quality equipment suited to your role. Home office support: £500 contribution toward your home office setup. Learning and development: Generous learning budget to support continued professional growth. Healthcare: Private medical insurance. Additional perks: A range of other benefits depending on location. Professional support: Structured onboarding and a collaborative environment that encourages learning and shared problem-solving.

jobs.title: Data QA Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Translate customer data extraction and web scraping requirements into clear, testable criteria and comprehensive QA strategies, taking ownership of quality assurance from the beginning of new projects. Perform exploratory, manual, and visual testing, complemented by automated testing where it provides measurable value. Execute test cycles on extracted datasets to validate compliance with customer specifications and identify inconsistencies, inaccuracies, missing information, and other defects. Document defects clearly and thoroughly, providing reproducible steps and supporting evidence so developers can investigate and resolve issues efficiently. Apply descriptive statistics, data summaries, and visualizations to assess completeness, accuracy, consistency, and data drift. Prepare quality reports and scoring metrics that communicate results honestly to internal teams and, where appropriate, customers. Clearly identify the scope of testing, any untested areas, and the associated risks to support informed project decisions. Collaborate with project managers and customers to clarify ambiguous requirements and ensure that expectations are measurable and testable before QA begins. Contribute to the development and improvement of test automation frameworks, with an emphasis on coverage, reliability, and performance. Identify, propose, and implement improvements to QA processes and tooling, including browser extensions, spreadsheet add-ons, and user-interface-based testing tools. Work independently while maintaining close collaboration with QA leadership, developers, and project managers to uphold quality standards throughout delivery. Requirements: At least 5 years of experience as a QA Engineer or in a comparable role involving software testing, data testing, or data quality assurance. Proficiency in Python for data analysis and validation, preferably using Pandas and Jupyter notebooks. Basic to intermediate SQL skills, including the ability to query and validate data in at least one relational database environment. Strong understanding of web technologies and protocols, including HTML, XPath, JSON, HTTP, and CSS. Experience testing HTTP/REST APIs and validating their responses against expected requirements. Our partner is looking for a Clinical Site Payment Associate Manager based in Germany. As a Clinical Site Payment Associate Manager, you will play a key role in managing clinical trial site payments, ensuring financial accuracy, regulatory compliance, and timely compensation for research sites and investigators. You will oversee payment processes from data review and invoice validation to reconciliation, accruals, and forecasting, helping maintain financial transparency across clinical studies. Working with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders in an international environment, you will support the smooth execution of clinical research activities. You will use financial systems and clinical trial platforms to analyze payment data, resolve discrepancies, and improve reporting processes. The role also offers the opportunity to contribute to operational innovation by identifying ways to leverage artificial intelligence and automation in clinical payments. With a strong focus on accountability, customer service, and continuous improvement, you will help strengthen financial operations across the healthcare and life sciences sectors. Oversee invoice management: Review clinical site invoices when required, investigate discrepancies, resolve payment-related issues, and provide clear, timely responses to questions or findings. Perform financial reconciliations: Reconcile payment records, prepare accurate payment accruals and forecasts, and ensure financial information remains consistent across relevant systems and reporting tools. Develop and maintain reporting: Create, update, and maintain standardized reports that support payment monitoring, financial oversight, operational visibility, and informed decision-making. Collaborate with stakeholders: Work closely with internal teams and external partners to coordinate payment activities, resolve complex issues, and maintain a high standard of customer-oriented service. Maintain accurate documentation: Prepare, collect, and maintain process, project, contractual, and financial documentation to support operational consistency, transparency, and audit readiness. Support continuous improvement: Adapt to evolving systems, processes, and regulatory requirements while contributing practical recommendations that improve the quality and reliability of clinical payment operations. Relevant professional experience: At least five years of experience in clinical payments, with a strong understanding of the end-to-end clinical site payment process. jobs.title: 3PL Operations Manager
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Manage the international 3PL network: Oversee external warehouses and third-party logistics partners across EMEA, the United States, and APAC, ensuring consistent operational performance and compliance with established standards. Lead partner and contract management: Own service-level agreements (SLAs), rate cards, contract renewals, and renegotiations in collaboration with Procurement and Legal. Conduct monthly operational reviews and quarterly business reviews, agree on improvement plans, and act as the primary escalation point for partner-related issues. Oversee daily warehouse operations: Establish and enforce standard operating procedures covering receiving, put-away, storage, picking, packing, dispatch, and returns. Ensure appropriate handling of heavy, fragile, and high-value equipment, including racks, GPU servers, and hardware security modules. Monitor performance and resolve incidents: Track operational KPIs through warehouse management systems, reports, and site visits. Lead root-cause investigations into damaged or missing inventory, incorrect shipments, and delivery delays, ensuring corrective and preventive actions are completed on time. Maintain inventory accuracy and audit readiness: Coordinate cycle counts, annual stocktakes, and reconciliations between physical inventory and ERP/WMS records. Organize warehouse inspections, resolve stock discrepancies with Back Office teams, maintain accurate asset records, and support internal and external audits, including SOX-related controls. Coordinate cross-functional logistics activities: Align inbound and outbound volumes with Logistics Planning and Transport teams, coordinate hardware staging and kitting with data center operations and project managers, and work with Security to enforce access controls, surveillance, pre-arrival procedures, and secure-storage requirements. Ensure reliable systems and data exchange: Maintain accurate, timely information flows between external logistics providers and internal ERP/WMS platforms, including advance shipping notices, inventory reports, and system integrations. Control budgets and optimize costs: Own the 3PL budget across storage, handling, value-added services, and additional charges. Validate invoices against contractual terms and actual activity, resolve billing disputes, monitor cost per pallet, rack, or movement, and identify savings through consolidation, space optimization, and contract renegotiation. Develop and optimize the warehouse network: Assess storage capacity requirements against data center expansion plans and demand forecasts. Lead provider selection through RFI/RFQ processes and site assessments, coordinate onboarding and go-live activities, and manage provider exits and stock transfers with complete traceability and no inventory loss. Manage compliance and operational risks: Ensure external warehouses meet applicable security, safety, insurance, and customs requirements, including bonded-storage requirements where relevant. Maintain audit-ready documentation and develop contingency plans to mitigate operational disruptions and supplier dependency risks. Lead and develop the 3PL team: Manage and develop external warehouse specialists as the function grows, establish priorities and clear responsibilities, and define effective workflows and escalation paths across 3PL operations, warehouse teams, and transport functions. Drive continuous improvement: Track and improve key performance indicators, including SLA compliance, inventory accuracy, incident rates, corrective-action closure, audit outcomes, cost efficiency, and invoice accuracy.
