jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Product Delivery & Launch Readiness: Own the engineering roadmap from beta through general availability and standalone commercial launch, partnering with product management on requirements, estimates, prioritization, delivery sequencing, and launch-readiness criteria. Service Reliability & Performance: Define and validate the service's operational limits, including throughput, latency, rate limiting, availability targets, and service-level objectives (SLOs), ensuring the platform meets production requirements. Detection Quality & Accuracy: Establish a continuous detection quality framework using representative test datasets, automated false-positive and false-negative testing, regression suites, and monitoring to maintain and improve detection performance. Automation Coverage & Classification: Guide detection capabilities for AI agents, assistants, stealth automation, headless browsers, and other emerging frameworks. Evolve classification systems to provide detailed context, confidence levels, identity verification status, and reason codes. Safe Deployment & Continuous Improvement: Manage staged rollouts of detection updates using feature flags, rollback procedures, and measurable release criteria. Incorporate customer feedback and reported detection errors into prioritized engineering improvements. Team Leadership & Development: Lead, coach, and develop a small team of senior engineers, manage recruitment as the team grows, and establish clear ownership, accountability, and opportunities for professional growth. Engineering Standards & Operational Excellence: Introduce effective engineering practices, including technical specifications, code review standards, repository ownership, and performance benchmarks covering delivery speed, throughput, predictability, failure rates, and recovery time. Cross-Team Collaboration: Establish effective working agreements with adjacent engineering teams, clarify shared responsibilities, and progressively reduce dependencies that prevent independent development and deployment. AI-Native Engineering Leadership: Lead an agent-first development workflow in which AI tools support specification, coding, review, and security checks, with appropriate human oversight for critical changes. Maintain and improve the tools, instructions, and review frameworks that enable this approach. Measurement & Knowledge Sharing: Evaluate the effectiveness of AI-assisted development against established engineering baselines, conduct regular performance reviews, and document lessons learned to inform broader engineering practices. API Design & Integration Standards: Ensure all product interfaces follow a contract-first approach, with OpenAPI specifications, automated breaking-change detection, generated documentation and SDKs, and APIs that are accessible to both developers and AI agents. Observability & Executive Communication: Own service observability through logs, metrics, traces, and SLOs. Communicate engineering progress, technical trade-offs, detection quality, and launch readiness clearly to leadership, product partners, and customer-facing teams. Strong Technical Foundation: At least eight years of software engineering experience before or alongside management. Ability to critically assess technical designs and pull requests, engage in architectural discussions, and make sound technical decisions when trade-offs arise. Relevant Domain Expertise: Strong experience in at least one of the following areas: bot detection or management, fraud and abuse prevention, web security, browser or client-side engineering, or high-volume API services. jobs.title: Data Scientist (Time Series Forecasting)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Time Series Forecasting: Design, develop, and refine forecasting models for weather conditions, energy market prices, and electricity grid supply and demand. Production Model Development: Translate forecasting algorithms and analytical models into robust, scalable, production-ready code that integrates with and powers a live energy trading platform. Data Analysis & Model Optimization: Analyze relevant datasets, identify patterns and trends, and improve forecasting accuracy to support reliable, data-driven trading decisions. AI-Assisted Development: Incorporate agentic coding tools into daily development workflows to accelerate implementation, improve productivity, and support efficient software development. Technical Integration: Work with data pipelines, analytical systems, and production environments to ensure forecasting solutions are reliable, maintainable, and suitable for operational use. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate technical findings, explain forecasting approaches, and collaborate effectively with distributed teams to align model development with business and platform requirements. Requirements: Educational Background: Bachelor's degree or higher in Mathematics, Econometrics, Physics, Engineering, or another closely related quantitative discipline. Professional Experience: At least three years of relevant professional experience in data science, quantitative analysis, forecasting, or a related field. Time Series Forecasting Expertise: Demonstrated experience developing and applying time series forecasting models, with the ability to translate quantitative methods into practical solutions. Programming Skills: Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for data analysis, model development, and production implementation. Experience with Go is considered an advantage. Agentic Coding Tools: Regular, hands-on use of agentic coding tools as part of your daily development workflow, with the ability to integrate AI-assisted techniques effectively into software development. Communication Skills: Excellent English communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and collaborate with stakeholders in a remote, international environment. Analytical & Problem-Solving Abilities: Strong quantitative reasoning, attention to detail, and a practical approach to addressing complex forecasting challenges and improving model performance. Preferred Industry Knowledge: Experience working with energy markets, electricity trading, power grid data, or weather datasets is a plus. Benefits: Fully Remote Work: Work remotely from anywhere in a distributed team environment. International Collaboration: Opportunity to contribute to a global energy trading platform and collaborate with professionals across different locations. Meaningful Technical Impact: Develop forecasting solutions that support real-world energy market decisions and operational trading activities. Advanced Data Science Challenges: Work on practical applications of time series forecasting involving weather, market prices, and electricity supply and demand. Modern Development Practices: Use agentic coding tools and contemporary development workflows to improve productivity and streamline model implementation. Professional Growth: Strengthen your expertise in quantitative modeling, production-grade data science, and applied forecasting in the energy sector.

jobs.title: Senior Web Browser Researcher
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: You will lead independent technical research into browser behavior and identification techniques, ensuring that discoveries are validated, actionable, and translated into meaningful improvements across device intelligence and fraud detection. Research novel device-identification, visitor-identification, Smart Signals, and bot-detection techniques across modern web browsers, working effectively with ambiguous or evolving requirements. Evaluate research findings against real-world constraints, including performance budgets, execution contexts, same-site behavior, proxy implications, and interactions with existing signals. Produce structured research outputs, including internal reports, technical articles, proofs of concept, experimental signal implementations, and supporting analyses. Collaborate with product and engineering partners to translate complex technical findings into actionable development priorities. Contribute to the research team's growth through mentorship, peer review, knowledge sharing, and public technical thought leadership. Requirements: You should have deep expertise in web technologies and browser behavior, combined with strong experimental skills and the ability to turn independent research into validated, measurable outcomes. You should be comfortable navigating undocumented technical behavior and communicating complex findings clearly to both technical and product stakeholders. Deep understanding of web platform fundamentals, browser internals, and web security concepts. Strong proficiency in JavaScript and the ability to read, understand, and navigate code written in multiple programming languages. Solid knowledge of web networking fundamentals. Demonstrated ability to uncover and explain undocumented behavior in web technologies, APIs, and protocols through testing, debugging, and reverse engineering. Experience independently driving research from an initial idea through experimentation, validation, and actionable recommendations. Ability to design and execute experiments using real-world traffic and analyze large-scale datasets to validate findings. Recognized depth in at least one relevant area, such as reverse engineering, network research, or device identification, alongside working knowledge of adjacent fields. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain research outcomes, expected impact, limitations, and trade-offs to engineering and product teams. Familiarity with anti-fingerprinting techniques and their implementation across browsers and browser extensions. A public research portfolio, such as conference presentations, technical blog posts, CVEs, or open-source contributions. Interest in mentoring colleagues, conducting peer reviews, and sharing research with the wider technical community. Maintain a consolidated view of ongoing initiatives to coordinate parallel work, prevent conflicts, and protect delivery outcomes. Track releases and communicate what has shipped, what is rolling out, and what is blocked, providing clear explanations of delivery decisions. Identify stalled initiatives, resolve bottlenecks, and proactively address issues that could affect delivery. Lead a small team of contract engineers working across central services and data, including setting priorities, conducting one-on-one meetings, and providing performance feedback. Automate operational workflows by integrating systems through APIs, connecting tools, and reducing manual status tracking. Develop consolidated dashboards that provide visibility into applications, infrastructure, data systems, and release progress, bringing together information from multiple sources. Integrate AI tools into engineering workflows to improve productivity, coordination, and decision-making. Oversee core delivery practices, including planning, commitments, retrospectives, release ownership, and accountability. Requirements: You should bring a strong technical foundation, practical delivery leadership experience, and a proactive approach to automation. The ideal candidate can engage with engineers as a technical peer while keeping projects organized, stakeholders informed, and teams focused on the right priorities. Professional software development experience, with a subsequent focus on technical program management or delivery coordination. Ability to read code, write scripts, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams; no specific programming language is required. Demonstrated ability to automate workflows, call APIs, integrate tools, and build reporting solutions independently. Practical experience using AI tools extensively, with sound judgment about their strengths, limitations, and appropriate applications. Experience managing delivery or release reporting for a team that ships software regularly. Previous experience leading engineers or a small technical team, including setting priorities and supporting team performance. Strong prioritization skills and the ability to distinguish genuine urgency from competing demands. Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to document decisions and communicate progress clearly. A calm, dependable leadership style that encourages early communication and proactive problem-solving. Nice to Have: Experience with live-service products, real-money gaming, or regulated products. Familiarity with mobile release management, including Apple App Store and Google Play processes. Experience administering Jira or Confluence. Knowledge of incident response and on-call practices. Experience with AWS or another cloud platform. Benefits: Contract-based engagement. Opportunity to work across central services, DevOps, data, and engineering operations. Hands-on ownership of automation, reporting, and delivery improvement initiatives. Opportunity to lead a small team of contract engineers. Exposure to AI-enabled engineering workflows and a complex, real-money gaming technology environment. Compensation, healthcare, paid leave, and other benefits are not specified in the provided job description.

jobs.title: Staff Application Security Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As a Staff Application Security Engineer, you will serve as the technical foundation of the application security function, translating security strategy into effective engineering practices, tools, and measurable improvements. Your responsibilities will include: Design and implement a secure software development lifecycle (SDLC), incorporating security requirements, design-time threat modeling, secure code reviews, and pre-release testing into existing engineering workflows. Own and improve application security tooling, including static and dynamic application security testing (SAST/DAST), software composition analysis (SCA), dependency scanning, secrets detection, and container and infrastructure-as-code scanning. Integrate security tools into CI/CD pipelines, reduce false positives, establish clear vulnerability ownership and remediation service-level agreements (SLAs), and ensure findings lead to meaningful action. Develop an AI-first security engineering approach using AI-assisted vulnerability triage, automated remediation, security review agents, and AI-augmented testing, with evidence-based controls governing what these tools can flag, block, or fix. Build reusable security patterns, hardened libraries, and secure defaults for authentication, authorization, input validation, secrets management, and cryptographic operations. Contribute directly to production codebases by implementing security fixes, developing security libraries, and building automation and CI integrations. Lead threat modeling and architecture security reviews for new products, features, and significant technical changes across APIs, web and mobile SDKs, dashboards, and data pipelines. Manage vulnerability identification, risk assessment, prioritization, and remediation for findings from security scanners, penetration tests, bug bounty reports, and customer disclosures. Conduct hands-on security testing, including manual code review and exploitation testing for authentication and authorization weaknesses, API vulnerabilities, injection attacks, server-side request forgery (SSRF), business-logic flaws, and abuse scenarios. Pay particular attention to adversarial threats involving fraud detection and bot mitigation, identifying weaknesses that could allow attackers to bypass or undermine platform protections. Collaborate with penetration testing and compliance specialists to scope assessments, validate fixes, retest findings, and translate technical discoveries into actionable engineering work. Lead technical investigations of application-layer security incidents, coordinating containment, root-cause analysis, remediation, and collaboration with cloud infrastructure teams when necessary. Define application security logging and alerting requirements and partner with engineering and cloud platform teams to implement effective detection capabilities. Support engineering teams through security consultations, office hours, secure coding guidance, and a Security Champions program that expands security expertise across the organization. Develop practical secure coding training based on real application code, vulnerabilities, and lessons learned from security incidents. Mentor engineers through code reviews and architecture feedback, helping improve security awareness and engineering quality without relying solely on mandates. Partner with application security leadership to shape technical priorities, communicate findings and risk assessments, and execute initiatives that advance the broader security roadmap. Provide technical evidence for security controls, contribute to vendor security assessments, and support enterprise customer due diligence, security questionnaires, architecture discussions, and penetration testing summaries. Requirements: The ideal candidate is an accomplished security engineer who combines strong software development skills with extensive practical application security experience. You should be comfortable independently

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Application Security
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As Senior Manager, Application Security, you will establish and lead the application security strategy while providing direction across IT operations and compliance. You will remain technically engaged in security initiatives while building a scalable program that supports engineering excellence, customer confidence, and business growth. Define and own the application security roadmap, including vulnerability management, threat modeling, security reviews, and remediation processes for new features and architectural changes. Conduct hands-on security reviews, triage vulnerabilities, collaborate with engineers on remediation, and progressively develop processes that allow the application security program to scale. Embed security-by-default practices throughout the software development lifecycle, including secure development standards, dependency management, secrets hygiene, and automated security scanning integrated into CI/CD pipelines. Design and implement an AI-first application security strategy, evaluating AI-assisted code analysis, vulnerability triage, remediation agents, and automated testing while establishing appropriate validation and oversight. Partner with engineering teams to ensure security practices strengthen development capabilities rather than create unnecessary delivery bottlenecks. Oversee third-party and vendor security assessments, ensuring external providers meet appropriate security standards when handling sensitive customer information. Establish zero-trust security principles and collaborate with cloud platform leadership on network security, identity and access management, security logging, and alerting. Lead application-layer security incident response and coordinate with infrastructure teams on incidents involving cloud platforms or underlying systems. Manage and support the Compliance Lead and IT team, providing strategic direction, prioritization, organizational context, and professional development while respecting their operational expertise. Align application security, IT operations, and compliance under a unified strategy with shared standards, risk frameworks, and coordinated roadmaps. Oversee cross-functional priorities involving access reviews, identity governance, endpoint security, employee onboarding and offboarding, and the connection between application security controls and compliance evidence. Partner with compliance leadership to assess future frameworks and enterprise requirements, prioritize IT investments, and support continued compliance maturity beyond existing SOC 2 Type II certification. Represent security posture, compliance status, and IT health to engineering leadership, enterprise customers, prospects, and auditors. Own the security questionnaire and due diligence process, communicating technical controls, risk assessments, and remediation plans clearly to external stakeholders. Provide leadership with actionable recommendations on security risks, compliance priorities, and operational improvements rather than routine status updates. Requirements: The ideal candidate is an experienced application security practitioner who has successfully built or matured security programs and developed the leadership skills needed to guide experienced specialists. You should be comfortable working directly with engineers, making strategic decisions, and translating complex security topics into clear business priorities. At least 7 years of security experience, including substantial hands-on application security experience. Demonstrated success building or significantly maturing an application security program, including security reviews, threat modeling, vulnerability management, and penetration testing follow-up. Strong knowledge of secure software design, OWASP principles, common application vulnerabilities, and practical exploitation scenarios. jobs.title: Partner Engagement Manager
jobs.description: About Welocalize Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale. Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com MAIN PURPOSE OF JOB The Partner Engagement Management Team is responsible for measuring, monitoring, and optimizing performance of suppliers within a particular set of languages. Performance includes, but is not limited to, on-time delivery, adherence to all client and project specific requirements, and defect-free deliverables. This Team is responsible for understanding customer capacity requirements as communicated by the Program Squads and liaising with Talent Procurement to ensure such capacity requirements can be met. As part of ensuring capacity, the Supplier Performance Management Team will monitor supplier utilization and advise supplier selection to the Program Squads accordingly MAIN DUTIES: The following is a non-exhaustive list of responsibilities and areas of ownership of Partner Engagement Manager: Through engagement with Program Squad, make data-driven decisions regarding the most suitable suppliers for a specific account and/or content specialty. Suitability may be based on quality, OTD, market / language strategy, capacity needs, content specialty, or client specific requirements. Lead communication and onboarding of suppliers to new client programs, ensuring availability and suitability for such work. Maintain supplier skilling as it pertains to clients / Pantheon (proprietary) programs. Monitor utilization to ensure supplier usage is in alignment with strategies as defined by Program Operations, Partner Success, and Language Operations. Engage with Program Squads should adjustment in resource usage be necessary. Communicate with and support Talent Procurement in the creation of new recruitment campaigns to identify and onboard new suppliers to Welocalize. Ensure regular quality measuring of suppliers in alignment with Welocalize LQA strategy. Monitor and flag suppliers performing beneath defined Welocalize thresholds. Supplier performance is inclusive of OTD, time-to-accept task, language quality, adherence to instructions, etc. Initiate Quality Improvement Plan (QIP), RCAs or CAPAs, as needed. If QIP is deemed unsuccessful, inform Talent Procurement. Liaise with Program Squad to understand customer capacity requirements and take appropriate actions to ensure such requirements are consistently met. Responsible for overall performance (internal & external resources) of the languages, capacity planning, resource utilization, OTD, and quality. REQUIREMENTS: Education & Experience Proven experience in a fast-paced, client-centric environment, ideally in the translation or localization industry. Knowledge of the language services industry and a keen interest in its technology, process, competitive landscape, and emerging trends. Adept at data literacy; ability to understand and utilize data to make decisions. Flexible attitude with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, time-sensitive, and deadline-driven work environment. Problem-solving mindset that can proactively assess and mitigate risk. Can work within a team, contributing to the team's success, or work independently as needed.

jobs.title: Consumer Product Manager
jobs.description: About Soum Soum is a fast-growing B2C marketplace based in Riyadh, connecting buyers and sellers of used electronics and used cars across Saudi Arabia through our website and mobile app. Everything we do is built on trust: buyers need confidence in what they are getting, and sellers need confidence they will be paid fairly and quickly. With the recent launch of our subscription model for electronics and cars, Soum is building the go-to recommerce platform in the Kingdom. About the Role The Consumer Product Manager owns the experience our customers touch every day: how buyers discover, evaluate, pay for and receive a used phone or car, and how sellers list, price and get paid for what they sell. You will be the voice of the Soum customer inside the product team, turning deep consumer insight into features that grow conversion, repeat purchase and trust in the platform. You will work across the app and web, partnering with design, engineering, operations and commercial teams to ship quickly and learn from what we ship. Key Responsibilities: Own the roadmap for a core consumer area (such as the buyer journey, the seller journey or subscriptions), prioritising ruthlessly by impact on conversion, retention, GMV and customer trust. Build a deep, continuous understanding of Soum's customers through user interviews, usability testing, app reviews, customer support tickets and behavioural data. Optimise the end-to-end marketplace funnel: listing creation, search and discovery, product pages, checkout and payments (Mada, Apple Pay, BNPL), delivery tracking, returns and post-purchase experience. Design and improve trust features that make buying used feel safe, including device condition grading, car inspection reports, verified sellers, buyer protection, ratings and transparent pricing. Shape the subscription products for electronics and cars: the value proposition, packaging, onboarding, engagement and retention, working closely with Commercial and Finance on unit economics. Translate problems into clear PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, and run agile delivery with design and engineering, from discovery through release and iteration. Champion an Arabic-first, bilingual experience with high-quality RTL design and localisation for Saudi customers. Run a disciplined experimentation practice: form hypotheses, design A/B tests, define success metrics and make fast, evidence-based decisions on what to scale or kill. Monitor and report on core consumer KPIs, including conversion rate, listing-to-sale rate, activation, repeat purchase, subscription retention, NPS and customer complaints. Partner cross-functionally with Operations (inspection, logistics, customer service), Marketing and Growth (acquisition, CRM), and Finance to make sure product changes work end to end, not just on screen. Keep a close eye on regional and global marketplaces and recommerce players, and bring the best ideas back to Soum, adapted for our customers. Requirements: 2–4 years of product management experience on consumer-facing digital products such as marketplaces, e-commerce, fintech or consumer apps. A proven track record of shipping consumer features that moved measurable business metrics, and the ability to explain exactly how. Strong consumer intuition backed by data: comfortable with product analytics tools (e.g. Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4), funnel analysis and A/B testing; working SQL is a strong plus. Hands-on experience building for mobile (iOS and Android) and web. Solid understanding of two-sided marketplace dynamics, including supply and demand balance, liquidity, trust and pricing. Experience working closely with designers and engineers in an agile environment, with clear written specs and sharp prioritisation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management, able to align operations, commercial and tech teams around a decision. A true owner who moves fast, takes decisions with incomplete information and cares more about outcomes than output.

jobs.title: Account Manager - Commodities - Middle East & Africa
jobs.description: About the Role: As an Account Manager for Commodities in the MEIA (Middle East & Africa) region, you will play a pivotal role in driving commercial growth and expanding Kpler's presence across key regional markets. Operating as a strategic partner to our client portfolio, you will identify high-value expansion opportunities, negotiate profitable renewals, and elevate customer relationship management. By connecting client market needs directly with internal strategy, you will help shape product direction and empower regional market leaders with real-time trade intelligence. Key Responsibilities Drive Portfolio Expansion: Direct and grow a portfolio of strategic accounts across the MEA region, systematically uncovering and closing upsell and cross-sell opportunities to exceed growth targets. Deliver Strategic Commercial Guidance: Partner with clients to align Kpler intelligence with their multi-year planning, demand forecasting, and operational workflows. Lead Contract Negotiations: Commercialize and negotiate renewals and expansion agreements, ensuring profitable terms and complete compliance with company policies. Capture Market & Competitor Insights: Gather direct feedback from client interactions to inform product development, business unit initiatives, and competitive positioning. Maintain Pipeline & CRM Accuracy: Manage sales activity and account health within Salesforce, providing predictable pipeline forecasts in close collaboration with Sales Operations. jobs.title: Assistant Vice President – Data Science
jobs.description: JOB PURPOSE As an AVP– Data Science, you will design, build, and productionize advanced analytics and AI solutions that drive measurable business value. You will work closely with Data Product Owners, Data Analysts, BI Developers, and Data Quality Specialists to translate complex business challenges into data-driven models and experiments. Leveraging Python, SQL, and modern ML frameworks, you will develop scalable machine learning solutions that are explainable, governed, and aligned with organizational priorities. ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Translate business problems into data science projects by defining clear hypotheses, success metrics, and validation methods. Explore, clean, and transform structured and unstructured data using Python and SQL to prepare high-quality datasets for modeling. Design, train, and evaluate machine learning models using appropriate algorithms and statistical techniques (e.g., regression, classification, clustering, NLP, forecasting). Collaborate with engineering and platform teams to productionize AI models through reproducible pipelines and CI/CD workflows. Apply model explainability, fairness, and interpretability techniques (e.g., SHAP, LIME, feature importance) to ensure transparency and accountability. Support AI governance activities, including Model Risk Management (MRM) processes, ensuring compliance and responsible use of AI. Conduct and analyze A/B tests or controlled experiments to assess model and feature performance. Work with Data Product Owners to define business outcomes, monitor model performance post-deployment, and ensure continued relevance. Collaborate with Data Quality Specialists to ensure input data meets quality, lineage, and governance standards. Communicate results effectively through visualizations, storytelling, and presentations tailored to technical and non-technical audiences. RELATED YEARS OF EXPERIENCE 6+ years of experience in data science, applied machine learning, or advanced analytics. Proven experience delivering models that have been deployed and integrated into business processes or digital products. Experience working in agile, cross-functional teams with Product Owners, Data Analysts, and Data Engineers. FIELD OF EXPERIENCE Analytics, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence TECHNICAL AND INTERPERSONAL SKILLS Advanced proficiency in Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM). Strong command of SQL for data extraction, transformation, and validation. Experience working in Databricks or equivalent data and ML platforms. Familiarity with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow) and ML lifecycle tools (MLflow, Airflow, Docker, Kubernetes). Understanding of model explainability, ethics, fairness, and governance. Knowledge of AI governance processes and documentation standards, including Model Risk Management (MRM). Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, Snowflake) and APIs for integrating AI models into applications. Familiarity with version control (Git/GitHub) and collaborative coding practices. Excellent communication skills to explain technical findings in clear business terms. Collaborative and curious, with a passion for continuous learning and innovation QUALIFICATION Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Master’s degree or higher in Data Science, Machine Learning, or Applied Statistics is an advantage.
